programme.title: Guest List
programme.desc: Tom Wallisch and the Good Company crew return with their second full-length film, Guest List, featuring world class urban, park and backcountry skiing, all with their trademark fun style. Travel the world with Good Company as they seek out new cities, fresh pow and never been done tricks. The Guest List for this party is stacked and just getting started!

programme.title: Unsustainable / Insostenibile
programme.desc: Two friends begin a traverse in one of the wildest environments of the Italian Dolomites along the Alta Via delle Dolomiti Bellunesi. Is sustainable tourism possible in the last wild corner of the Dolomites? With this question in mind two friends set off on a walking adventure along the Alta Via delle Dolomiti Bellunesi, from the home of Santi Padros, a mountain guide and a Spaniard who moved to Val di Zoldo, to the home of Diego Toigo, instructor of CAI Feltre.

programme.title: Date with Nature Season 4 Episode 8
programme.desc: Date with Nature is a serene, anti-stress TV series designed to calm the mind and inspire a sense of balance and peace. Season Four, The Music of Nature, features 10 breathtaking new episodes, showcasing stunning landscapes and immersive natural stories captured by the teams at Living Nature HD and HOME 4K.

programme.title: Wild Atlantic Way
programme.desc: The Wild Atlantic Way, the world's longest coastal route, stretches 2,000 kilometers from the fishing village of Kinsale in County Cork to Derry in Northern Ireland. Renowned for its dramatic cliffs, picturesque villages, and breathtaking views, this iconic road offers more than just scenery, it's a journey deeply connected to the untamed beauty of nature. In September 2023, Pietro embarked on an extraordinary adventure, cycling the entire route using only his own strength.

programme.title: Kyrgyzstan Where Are You?
programme.desc: Kyrgyzstan, Where Are You? - Cycling in the Kingdom of the Eagles. Join a journey through the rugged landscapes of Kyrgyzstan, a cyclist's paradise nestled in Central Asia. Starting near Bishkek and pedal through the stunning Songkol Lake at 3,300 meters, surrounded by nomadic yurts and herds roaming the plains. Continue to Ysykkol, the second-largest mountain lake globally, exploring surreal rock formations like Mars Canyon and the Fairy Tale Canyon along the way.

programme.title: Dhaulagiri 2021
programme.desc: Dhaulagiri 2021 - The 7th Summit. In 2021, Marco Camandona and Pietro Picco, alpinists and alpine guides from the Aosta Valley in Italy, set off with an ambitious objective: to climb Dhaulagiri (8167m), the world's 7th tallest mountain in the purest of forms: without additional oxygen or external support. This adventure takes them to Kathmandu, then Pokhara and finally at the heart of the Himalaya, in between the world's tallest mountains.

programme.title: Alternative Surf Craft
programme.desc: Alternative Surf Craft profiles the surfers on the edge of the sport. These surfers carve their own path riding unique and alternative surf craft. Also includes personal insights by new wave surfer Trevor Gordon.

programme.title: Alternative Surf Craft
programme.desc: Alternative Surf Craft profiles the surfers on the edge of the sport. These surfers carve their own path riding unique and alternative surf craft. Also includes personal insights by new wave surfer Trevor Gordon.

programme.title: I Stay Home / Io Resto a Casa
programme.desc: The term "quarantine" comes from the 40 days of isolation to which ships returning from areas affected by the plague in the 14th century were subjected. On 30 January 2020, the WHO recommended 14 days of quarantine were necessary to contain the spread of the new Coronavirus. On the morning of 10 March 2020 all Italians woke up in quarantine. In "I stay home", I depict the first 14 days of the Italian lockdown without ever leaving my house.

programme.title: The Words of Wine / Le Parole del Vino
programme.desc: The Words of Wine - Azienda Agraria Fiorini. Nestled in the picturesque hills of Marche, the Fiorini farm has thrived for over a century, passed down through three generations. Founded in 1900 by agronomist Luigi Fiorini, the estate began with a vision and a vineyard. Guided by Luigi's passion, his son Valentino and wife Silvana expanded the legacy, creating a warm haven for wine enthusiasts.

programme.title: Le Passage / Il Passaggio
programme.desc: Those who live on the borders of the Alpes know it well: mountains are a place of passage, to be crossed or surmounted, constantly moving across passes. "Le Passage" portrays the history and daily life of two valleys between Italy and Switzerland. Semi Finalist - Montreal Independent Film Festival 2020. Official Selection 2017: Cervino Cinemountain.

programme.title: Kamchatka
programme.desc: An adventure on volcanoes for Aldo Mazzocchi accompanied by Alberto Zucchi and Ottavio Tomasini who documents it with photos and videos. The idea was born from the desire to get to know Kamchatka, a harsh, unspoiled and geologically very active territory. The four natural elements (water, fire, soil and air) coexist here without being modified by man.

programme.title: The Words of Wine: Alberto Quacquarini
programme.desc: Serrapetrona is a small town in the hills of central Italy, where time seems to stand still. Harsh winters and Mediterranean summers have shaped a landscape where nature and tradition exist in perfect harmony. It is here that Vernaccia di Serrapetrona DOCG, a rare and prestigious sparkling red wine, has its roots.This documentary tells the story of the Alberto Quacquarini winery, the leading producer of Vernaccia di Serrapetrona DOCG.

programme.title: Dust
programme.desc: DUST it is a motorsport project outside of the races, with riders and drivers training, testing or just having fun with their machines. From two wheels sports like Trial, Enduro, Rally Raid, Motocross, Sidecar to four wheels Rally, WRC, Group B legends and Rally Raid.

programme.title: Unsustainable / Insostenibile

programme.title: California Skies
programme.desc: (Also available with narration) California Skies is an experiential video that combines beautiful original music by award winning composer Alan Williams with 4K video images by multiple Emmy Award winner veteran cinematographer Howard Hall. California's turbulent atmosphere is revealed with time lapse photography as mountain, desert, and coastal landscapes are explored by ultralight aircraft.

programme.title: The Golden Trail / A Passo d'Oro
programme.desc: Franco Nones made history in 1968 by becoming the first non-Scandinavian to win Olympic gold in cross-country skiing. Born in Val di Fiemme, Italy, he began his athletic career as a cyclist before switching to skiing, where he quickly dominated national competitions. Despite being an underdog against the Nordic powerhouses, his determination and skill led him to victory at the Grenoble Olympics, changing the landscape of winter sports in Italy.

programme.title: Zero to Level
programme.desc: Zero to Level documents Aldo Mazzocchi's awe-inspiring journey from sea level to the summit of Kilimanjaro. This motor-free odyssey encompasses soft kayaking, mountain biking, mountaineering, and paragliding, traversing the four elements-water, earth, fire, and air. Accompanied by photographer Ottavio Tomasini, Aldo follows the reverse water cycle from the Indian Ocean to Kilimanjaro's peak. Paddling 190 km, biking 500 km, and ascending Kibo on foot, he conquers each challenge.

programme.title: BMX Street
programme.desc: From the creators of Youtube Channel phenomena "woozyBMX" which has over 60 million views on Youtube alone, 'BMX STREET' documents some of the best BMX Street Riders in Events & Jams. 'BMX STREET' showcases the fun and good times and also shows the struggle of pulling a trick which may involve a crash or two! Riders include: Bruno Hoffmann, Simone Barraco, Felix Prangenberg, Nico van Loon, Mike Curley, Mark Burnett, Joris Coulomb, Moritz Nussbaumer and many more!

programme.title: Never Give Up
programme.desc: Laura Rogora is a special person: the strongest female climber in the world ever and she's only 19. But Laura is one of those girls who has amazed us so much and in such a short period of time that we can't even imagine what she is capable to do. Today she is on her way to the Olympics in Tokio 2021. Official Selection 2022: In The Palace International Short Film Festival.

programme.title: Mountain Bike in Valle D'Aosta Episode 7
programme.desc: The mountain bike is one of the most interesting way of transport for discovering the Alpine territory. In fact, it allows you to move quickly on trails and farm roads, covering distances in a short time. The ebike has further extended this possibility and in this series of episodes Ettore Personnettaz will take you on a journey to discover places, territories, curiosities and above all people and friends who, like him, live in the splendid mountains of the Aosta Valley.

programme.title: Stone Will / Volontà di Pietra
programme.desc: Raised between Castel Thun and the woods above his home in the middle of the Dolomites, Alfredo has a very special bond with his land: his profession keeps him at work in the quarry all week and when he has some free time he gathers firewood for the home, takes care of his two donkeys, and works with iron. Alfredo also has a special passion that has changed his life: rock climbing.

programme.title: Rolly
programme.desc: The South face of the Marmolada marked the life and mountaineering evolution of Rolando Larcher: the Trentino climber legend arrived for the first time at the summit of the South at the age of 19, in 1985. Since then he continued to open up new routes around the world. The last route on this face, the "Scacciadiavoli", with passages of difficulty 8a+/8b.

programme.title: Elementa
programme.desc: Deep in Canada's Great Bear Rainforest lives a rare, unique and seldom seen creature, a black bear with white fur, known in these parts as Moksgm'ol (the ghost bear). According to local mythology, the creator Raven asked the Black bear to make one-in-ten cubs white, as a reminder of the Great White Time, when the world was covered in ice.

Through the voices of those who forged this legacy, young adventurers Christian and Claudia from Trentino's Valsugana discover the vertical world of a land they had never explored.

programme.title: Food Rebels / I Ribelli del Cibo
programme.desc: Through four stories, Food Rebels tells the life of small food producers, their enthusiasm and their difficulties, between minimum every day targets (in short, economical survival) and a very high ambition: changing the world of food, dominated by large retailers and low quality food. The microcosm of South Tyrol, a land where tradition and innovation go hand in hand and where you can find a particularly fertile humus, is the background of universal and urgent matters.

programme.title: Live: SportsCenter
programme.desc: Las últimas noticias, momentos destacados e información de todos los rincones del mundo del deporte se presenta cada día en "SportsCenter", el primer programa de ESPN cuando la red se estrenó en septiembre de 1979. La serie se transmite en tres ediciones nocturnas, luego se re-transmite la última edición cuatro veces cada mañana de lunes a viernes antes de despejar el escenario para un bloque de seis horas de "SportsCenter" en vivo, que pone más énfasis en la interactividad de los fanáticos, noticias, análisis, comentarios y la cobertura de las conferencias de prensa.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: Over the course of a year, twelve of the best GLORY featherweights will compete opposite twelve of the best RISE featherweights in a series of knockout bouts until one fighter becomes the Last Featherweight Standing.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY 100 features four GLORY world title bouts, four separate four-man one-night tournaments to determine who qualifies for the Last Heavyweight Standing finals, and several key matchups involving some of GLORY’s most popular fighters.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: Four more will punch their tickets into the next round as GLORY & RISE search for the baddest featherweight on the planet in this year long tournament. On the GLORY side, top ranked German Polish fighter Denis Wosik (40-9-1, 9 KO) takes on Thai veteran Suarek (107-40-11, 39 KO) and Italy’s Achraf Aasila (53-13, 13 KO) meets France’s Lounis Saing (19-4-1, 12 KO). Meanwhile on the RISE side of the bracket, Japan’s Yutaro Asahi (17-9, 4 KO) clashes with Spain’s Eduardo Catalin (17-3-1) and top Japanese prospect Yura Kono (15-1, 7 KO) goes up against China’s Dexiang Kong (35-10). In addition to the Last Featherweight Standing matchups, Shiro Matsumoto (53-17-4, 18 KO) defends his RISE bantamweight title against top challenger Masahi Kumura (24-7, 12 KO) and Australian KO artists Chadd Collins (64-18-2, 32) defends his RISE super lightweight championship against the great Kento Haraguchi (25-4-1, 14 KO).

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY 103: Last Heavyweight Standing main event features Levi Rigters (19-3, 9 KO) colliding with Jamal Ben Saddik (38-10, 29 KO) to see who moves on in the tournament. Among the other names taking part in Phase Two are Nabil Khachab (29-6-1, 4 KO), Iancu Ionut (31-11, 13 KO), Rade Opacic (21-7, 16 KO), Milos Cvjeticanin (13-4, 9 KO), Sofian Laidouni (39-5-1, 20 KO), and many more. In addition, Chico Kwasi (44-5-2, 23 KO) will defend his GLORY welterweight world title against Mehdi Ait El Hadj (35-4-2, 8 KO), Mory Kromah (34-3-1, 20 KO) returns and takes on Cristian Ristea (44-26, 13 KO) in a heavyweight match-up outside the tournament, and Tayfun Ozcan (88-11-3, 28 KO) clashes with rival Don Sno (6-2, 3 KO).

programme.desc: Former Light Heavyweight Champion Tarik Khbabez (52-12-1, 22 KO) and Bahram Rajabzabeh (72-5, 63 KO) collide in a huge showdown for the vacant Light Heavyweight title. programme.title: Live: The Leadoff Spot
programme.desc: Co-hosted by a combination of veteran baseball analysts - Steve Phillips, Xavier Scruggs and Eduardo Pérez - the program will deliver expert commentary, plus interviews with baseball newsmakers and club personnel.

programme.title: Live: MLB Central
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown.".

programme.title: Live: MLB Now
programme.desc: The hourlong weekday afternoon "MLB Now" presents the day's top stories in baseball by spanning the sport's cultural divide. Host Brian Kenny discusses the issues and provides analysis, with a bent toward modern analytics to prove his points. The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls.

programme.title: Live: Intentional Talk
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media.

programme.title: Remote Lakes, Big Fish, Epic Days
programme.sub-title: FishON - Spring Thaw on Frederick House Lake
programme.desc: Paul, Perry, and Dan head east of Timmins to the historic waters of Frederick House Lake for a late-season ice adventure under warm, spring-like skies. What starts as a perfect day on the hardwater quickly turns into a multispecies showcase—pike, perch, walleye, and sauger all keep the crew busy as the bite fires up. But as Northern Ontario weather often reminds us, conditions shift fast. Experience the thrill of reeling in massive catches while surrounded by breathtaking wilderness, and gain valuable tips and insights from Mark to enhance your own fishing techniques. This episode sets the tone for a season filled with excitement, exploration, and exceptional angling.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay’s Great Escape
programme.sub-title: Gordon Ramsay’s Great Escape S01 E01 - India Part 1
programme.desc: Gordon’s odyssey begins in the north, home of our curry house classics. On board an express train he’s thrown in at the deep end and experiences a back-to-basics baptism of fire, cooking for its many passengers in the train’s cramped pantry car and getting travel sick while he’s making curry. In stark contrast he then meets his match working for a cantankerous royal chef, preparing a biryani with a difference for a huge wedding feast before venturing into the jungle where he gets eaten alive by ants when he scales a 40-foot tree in search of the local tribe’s favourite delicacy. Then it’s on to Delhi to cook at the restaurant that invented tandoori chicken, where Gordon puts into practice everything he’s learnt for a tough crowd of Delhi food critics.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay’s Great Escape
programme.sub-title: Gordon Ramsay’s Great Escape S01 E02 - India Part 2
programme.desc: Gordon’s got a taste for adventure and heads off the tourist track into impenetrable north-east India, home of the country’s best-kept culinary secrets. Leaving the 21st century behind, he immerses himself in the life of a local meat-loving tribe in Nagaland, once better known for head-hunting than their curries. Then he’s off to Assam to enter a housewives’ competition to find the best Assamese dish; and finally he sets up shop among the street food stalls of Calcutta to try and tempt the local foodies into buying north-east curry – Ramsay style.

With the help of lawyer Tully Alford (Dan Hedaya), Fester manages to get the Addams clan evicted from their home. programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Al final de la década de los ochentas, en el negocio ilícito más lucrativo de la época, "el oro blanco", las rutas de las Bahamas y Florida, ya no son tan viables para el transporte de la cocaína; la persecución de los miembros de los carteles colombianos y su guerra entre ellos mismos se intensifica, generando que estos bandidos sean extraditados, encarcelados en su país o asesinados. Algunos son condenados al encierro voluntario, escondidos en algún rincón para evitar su captura, por cuenta de las fuerzas armadas o de sus enemigos. El negocio cambia y es cuando aparece Amado Carrillo Fuentes "El Señor de los Cielos" que en forma muy discreta se dedica al transporte del producto que proveen los narcotraficantes colombianos restantes, convirtiéndose en el narcotraficante más poderoso de los cuatro carteles que operan en México: el de Juárez, el del Golfo, el de Sinaloa y el de Tijuana. Su historia se devela en este drama cargado de acción y giros inusitados.

programme.title: 3ABN Sabbath School Panel
programme.desc: In this week’s lesson, we explore God's passionate and compassionate nature, emphasizing His emotional depth and love for humanity. The Bible portrays God’s love as far surpassing human love, using parental imagery to highlight His unwavering compassion (Isa. 49:15, Hos. 11:1-9). Despite human unfaithfulness, God’s love is enduring and visceral, as seen in Christ’s compassion during His ministry. Divine "jealousy" is understood as righteous passion, seeking an exclusive relationship with His people. Believers are called to reflect this love through the Spirit, as described in 1 Corinthians 13, by cultivating selflessness, kindness, and devotion to others, mirroring God’s perfect love.

programme.title: 3ABN Sabbath School Panel
programme.desc: Lesson 5 explores the concept of divine wrath as an expression of God's love. God's anger is directed against evil, injustice, and oppression, not out of arbitrary malice but in defense of His creation. Divine wrath is a loving response to the harm caused by sin, which hurts those God loves. Though God is slow to anger and abundant in compassion, His wrath is ultimately a righteous reaction to evil. Jesus also displayed righteous indignation, highlighting God's deep concern for justice. Christ’s atonement reconciles divine justice with mercy, offering salvation to believers from God's righteous judgment.

L'une des caractéristiques les plus étonnantes de cette symphonie est qu'elle est composée de seulement trois mouvements, ce qui en fait la seule œuvre symphonique majeure de la période classique sans menuet ni scherzo.

programme.title: Passion, devoir et amour - Les trois vies de Clara Schumann
programme.desc: Clara Schumann compte parmi les pianistes et compositrices les plus talentueuses de l'ère romantique. Qui fut-elle vraiment, derrière l'artiste prodige, l'épouse passionnée et la mère exemplaire ? Retour sur ces trois facettes de sa personnalité.

programme.title: Barbara Hannigan at Severance Hall

En automne 2023, elle fit ses débuts attendus à la direction du Cleveland Orchestra. Le programme proposait un mélange intéressant d'ancien et nouveau avec la Symphonie N° 44 en mi-mineur de Haydn, 'Lonely Child' de Vivier, 'Lontano' de Ligeti et Mort et Transfiguration de Richard Strauss.

programme.title: In the Organ's Stomach
programme.desc: Olivier Latry is the current holder of the Great Organ of Notre Dame. Between its original religious function and the interest of composers of all times, the great organ Cavaillé-Coll reveals its absolute modernity. Latry is considered one of the greatest organists of his generation, both in France and internationally. He sees himself as an ambassador of French music from the 17th through the 20th centuries as well as an advocate for the art of improvisation.

programme.title: Mahler, Symphonie Nr. 1 D-Dur
programme.desc: Die Wiener Philharmoniker unter der Leitung von Leonard Bernstein spielen die Symphonie Nr. 1 D-Dur von Gustav Mahler (1860-1911). Diese Aufnahme entstand im Oktober 1974 im Wiener Konzerthaus. Als erster Dirigent nahm Leonard Bernstein alle Symphonien Gustav Mahlers nicht nur auf Schallplatte, sondern auch auf Video auf. Bernsteins Mahler-Zyklus ist ein einzigartiges musikalisches Dokument und trug zu einem neuen Verständnis von Mahlers Werk bei.

programme.title: The Unanswered Ives
programme.desc: “The Unanswered Ives” is the first documentary about American modernist composer Charles Ives (1874-1954). Ives was among the first generation of American composers that achieved international acclaim. Born in 1874, in Danbury, Connecticut, Ives took music lessons at a young age, becoming a church organist at the age of 14. Following his graduation from the music department at Yale University, the young composer decided to pursue a career outside of the arts.

programme.desc: Die Dirigentin Marien van Staalen leitet das Amadeus Ensemble Rotterdam in einer Aufführung von Wolfgang Amadeus Mozarts Klarinettenkonzert in A-Dur, KV 622. Henk de Graaf ist der vorgestellte Solist. Diese Aufführung wurde in der St.-Nikolaus-Kirche in Vollenhove, Niederlande, aufgenommen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: In der Probe: Esa-Pekka Salonen
programme.desc: Der finnische Komponist und Dirigent Esa-Pekka Salonen war von 1992 bis 2009 Musikdirektor des Los Angeles Philharmonic. Unter seiner dynamischen Leitung wurde das Orchester als eines der herausragendsten der Welt anerkannt. Die spannende musikalische Partnerschaft, die Salonen mit seinen Musikern aufgebaut hat, wurde in der internationalen Presse weithin gelobt. Die Klarheit, Effizienz und Bescheidenheit des Dirigenten haben eine entspannte Zusammenarbeit zwischen ihm und dem Orchester gefördert, die sich besonders im Probenprozess zeigt. Diese Episode "In Rehearsal" zeigt Salonen bei der Probe von Claude Debussys impressionistischem Orchesterwerk La Mer mit dem Los Angeles Philharmonic im Dorothy Chandler Pavilion des Musikzentrums des Los Angeles County. Sie bietet einen faszinierenden Einblick in Salonens Verhältnis zu seinen Musikern und auch in Debussys Meisterwerk. (Senderinfo).

programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. Schumann composed most of the work during his stay in Vienna in 1839, where he wrote the first four movements, presenting pictures of lively carnival revelry.

When Thanksgiving break rolls around, Rebecca, no longer an innocent farm girl, invites Crawl back to South Dakota, where he pretends to be her fiancé.

Aided by his goofy friend Stoney (Pauly Shore), Dave transports their discovery to his garage, where the Neanderthal thaws and is revived. When Dave and Stoney find the living and thoroughly bewildered caveman, they attempt to pass him off as a foreign exchange student named Link (Brendan Fraser), resulting in many misadventures.

programme.title: Daria
programme.desc: Una prueba vocacional dice que las profesiones ideales de Daria y Quinn son de sepulturera y modelo. Daria es obligada a trabajar con Kevin vendiendo nueces para mejorar su desenvolvimiento social.

programme.title: Daria
programme.desc: La amenaza de un huracán en Lawndale causa en la gente el raro efecto de empezar a cantar y a bailar. Daria y Jane suben a la terraza del colegio para no tener que asistir al partido de fútbol americano pero finalmente es cancelado.

programme.title: Daria
programme.desc: La gran casa de los Lane comienza a llenarse de diversos familiares. Primero se escapa Jane a pedirle a Daria pasar unos días en su casa, luego Trent hace lo mismo y finalmente Amanda Lane.

programme.title: Daria
programme.desc: Jake sufre un infarto y lentamente se recupera en casa, Helen tiene que lidiar con su suegra. Quinn quiere ser cardióloga para ayudar a Jake en caso de futuros ataques.

programme.title: Daria
programme.desc: Daria consigue registro de conducir, y en su primer uso del mismo tiene que ir con Quinn a pagar una fianza para sacar a Jane, Trent y el resto de la banda de la cárcel por una violación de tráfico.

programme.title: Daria
programme.desc: Una enorme red de confusiones, extraños eventos y malentendidos crea múltiples sospechas en Daria de que invasiones marcianas y espionajes comunistas han logrado apoderarse del vecindario de Lawndale.

programme.desc: Efter at have taget afsked med en af deres egne, må træningslejrkandidaterne se sandheden i øjnene - ingen plads i truppen er sikker. Hårdføre Kitty Carter bliver bedt om at arbejde med de svage kandidater og få dem i form.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 6
programme.desc: Hele gruppen trænger til at blive rusket og gæstekoreografen Kitty Carter står til tjeneste. Truppen må gennemlide en benhård dansetime og nogle af pigerne bryder totalt sammen. Så er det tid til en lektie i DCC's etikette.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 7
programme.desc: Nogle drømme går i opfyldelse, når de heldige træningslejr-kandidater står model i den ikoniske Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders-dragt under en sexet fotooptagelse.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 8
programme.desc: Flere skal sorteres fra, og der er kun to undervisningstimer tilbage, men pigerne kæmper for at få deres berømte cowboystøvler på for første gang. Så skal Judy og Megan Fox give kritik ved den sidste dans.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 1
programme.desc: 600 nervøse og spændte Dallas Cowboys Cheerleader-aspiranter ankommer til et hotel til de første udtagelser. Hver deltager får mindre end to minutter til at udføre en freestyle-danserutine foran dommerne.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 2
programme.desc: I de sidste udtagelser er det kun de stærkeste, der overlever. DCC-aspiranterne skal nu konkurrere mod veteranerne om en plads i træningslejren.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 3
programme.desc: Hvis kandidaterne troede, at udtagelserne var hårde, får de sig en overraskelse, når den brutale træningslejr går i gang. Uge 1 på Valley Ranch starter med, at pigerne finder ud af, hvad dommerne havde at sige om dem.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 4
programme.desc: Det er kun den tredje uge af træningslejren, men det er allerede tid til at frasortere. Hvem vil overleve? Ugen starter med en dragtprøve, hvor aspiranterne får lov til at prøve den berømte blå, hvide og stjernebestrøede dragt.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 5
programme.desc: Det er tid til at få pigernes DCC-look frem. Glat eller krøllet hår? Lyshåret eller rødhåret? Pigerne ved ingenting om, hvad Kelli og frisøren Rainer Schneck har planlagt for dem, når de får deres dramatiske DCC-makeover.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 6
programme.desc: Da DCC-chefen Kelli Finglass giver en tidligere aspirant en unik chance for at springe til på træningslejren efter tre uger, har hun meget at indhente.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 7
programme.desc: Hun er tilbage! Den krævende Kitty Carter kommer til Valley Ranch for at undervise de nervøse DCC-dansere i danseteknik. Så tager Charlotte Jones Anderson de forundrede cheerleadere på en privat rundtur i det nye Cowboys Stadium.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 8
programme.desc: Kelli og Judy må tage svære beslutninger, som er retfærdige, men beklagelige. Det er opgørets time for de resterende træningslejrkandidater, da der kun er to dansetimer tilbage før den sidste eliminering.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 1
programme.desc: For første gang er det pragtfulde Cowboys Stadium i Texas basen for udtagelserne til Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders. Over 600 aspiranter med drømme om at komme med i truppen 2010-2011 ankommer før solopgang til indledningsrunden.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 2
programme.desc: De 47 nye piger, som skal deltage i DCC's finaleudtagelser, har haft to uger til at forberede sig, men er de klar til at danse sammen med de 27 tilbagevendende DCC-veteraner?

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 3
programme.desc: DCC's træningslejr begynder i aften! Kandidaterne ankommer til Valley Ranch for første gang og får muligheden for at møde deres idoler og mentorer - DCC-veteranerne.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 4
programme.desc: Den anden uge af træningslejren bliver nogle af aspiranterne sendt hjem. Nogle få udvalgte veteraner skal filme et segment til Good Morning America, og de hjælper med at realisere en livslang drøm for en heldig dame.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 5
programme.desc: Uge fire af træningslejren begynder med, at de nye får en DCC-makeover. Fra hår og sminke til selvbruner og tandblegning bliver aspiranterne forvandlet til DCC-repræsentanter.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 6
programme.desc: Træningslejren er snart slut, og DCC-portrætterne står på banen. Træningslejr-aspiranterne og veteranerne er klar til deres nærbilleder, klædt i specialsyede DCC-dragter med perfekt hår og makeup.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 7
programme.desc: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders-truppen 2010 bliver bekendtgjort i løbet af de næste to dage. Det siger sig selv, at det er en stressende tid for træningslejr-aspiranterne. Tiden er inde til at imponere.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 8
programme.desc: 34 nyankomne og veteraner møder op i dragten for at tage gruppebilledet. Men der sættes en dæmper på glædes dag, fordi Dallas Cowboy Cheerleaders direktør og koreograf endnu ikke har offentliggjort truppen 2010.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Prøverne begynder
programme.desc: Cowboys Stadium i Arlington, Texas huser igen optagelsesprøverne til Dallas Cowboys' cheerleadere. 500 kandidater, der drømmer om at komme på DCC-holdet i 2011-12, ankommer før solopgang til de første prøver.

programme.desc: "Special delivery for Boots the monkey!" Boots' favorite boots are back from the shoe shop, but when he tries them on, he starts to bounce, bounce, bounce. These aren't his boots—these are bouncy boots.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora reads us a Mayan story about twin brothers who were amazing ball players. A long time ago in a Mayan kingdom, there was a big ball game championship.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.sub-title: Dora Saves the Three Little Piggies
programme.desc: Dora and Boots are reading their favorite story, "The Three Little Pigs" when suddenly we hear the piggies calling out for help. Their brick house is missing some bricks, and the Big Bad Wolf is going to blow it down!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.sub-title: The Big Red Chicken's Magic Show
programme.desc: ABRACADABRA! The Big Red Chicken's putting on a magic show for all of his friends. With an "abracadabra," he pulls a rabbit out of his hat, but when it's time to make the bunny disappear, it doesn't work!

programme.title: Dossiers FBI: Paiment final
programme.desc: En 1980, des criminels laissent une bombe de 500 kilos dans un casino du Nevada et exigent la somme d’un million de dollars pour la désamorcer. C’est la plus grosse bombe que le FBI ait jamais vue.

programme.title: Dossiers FBI: Résistance extrême
programme.desc: En 1970, Otpor, un violent mouvement de résistance croate, commet des actes terroristes contre les Croates vivant aux États-Unis et ne soutenant pas leur cause.

programme.title: Dossiers FBI: À l’abri de la loi
programme.desc: En Californie, l’agent de police George Gwaltney découvre le corps de Robin Bishop, 23 ans, assassinée près de sa voiture sur une route isolée. Gwaltney déclare qu’il est innocent et il est acquitté à deux reprises mais.

programme.title: Dossiers FBI: Un instinct de tueur
programme.desc: À Washington, une enseignante est abattue au moment où elle monte dans sa voiture. Le meurtrier laisse son corps dans le stationnement et s’enfuit avec son véhicule.

programme.title: Dossiers FBI: Poursuite internationale
programme.desc: À Langley en Virginie, un homme abat des individus en pleine heure de pointe. Le meurtre d’employés de la CIA met la population des États-Unis en état de choc.

programme.title: Dossiers FBI: Confiance absolue
programme.desc: En 1988, on fait la lumière sur la mort mystérieuse d’un fermier de la Caroline du Sud quand un criminel reconnaît avoir été engagé par deux importants membres de la communauté pour commettre ce meurtre.

programme.title: Dossiers FBI: Programme radical
programme.desc: Un patrouilleur du New Jersey est abattu sur l’autoroute 80 près de la limite de la Pennsylvanie. Des témoins de la fusillade identifient la voiture du tireur et les policiers la retrouvent quelques heures plus tard.

programme.title: Dossiers FBI: Guet-apens mortel
programme.desc: En Arizona, un chargement de billets de banque disparaît dans le désert, en même temps que les deux gardiens qui en assuraient le transport. Le FBI ignore si les deux hommes sont complices ou victimes d’une embuscade.

programme.title: Dossiers FBI: Frères de sang
programme.desc: Les habitants de la petite ville de Noel au Missouri sont abasourdis en apprenant qu’une de leur banque a été dévalisée, et ils le sont encore davantage quand ils découvrent que le président de la banque a disparu.

programme.title: Dossiers FBI: Chasse à l’homme
programme.desc: En Alaska, la police découvre les corps de plusieurs jeunes femmes dans des tombes peu profonde un peu partout dans la nature. Le tueur torture ses victimes. Il les traque comme des proies avant de les tuer d’une balle dans la tête.

programme.title: Dossiers FBI: Une question de secondes
programme.desc: En Californie, dans le quartier huppé de Lodi, une fillette de 12 ans est enlevée en plein jour. Les policiers et des agents du FBI se rendent immédiatement à sa maison, déterminés à retrouver la fillette au plus vite.

programme.title: Dossiers FBI: Rencontre dangereuse
programme.desc: En janvier 1984, un agent des douanes américaines disparaît de son poste à la frontière entre le Texas et le Mexique. La police se met alors à la recherche de 4 latinos américains à bord d’une Pontiac Grand Prix.

programme.title: Dossiers FBI: Le tireur
programme.desc: À la fin des années 1980, le FBI rivalise d’ingéniosité pour capturer un braqueur de banque rusé. L’homme, qui agit seul, est soupçonné d’avoir commis la série de vols de banque la plus importante de l’histoire du FBI.

programme.title: Dossiers FBI: Évasion fatale
programme.desc: Un homme a été étranglé chez lui. Son carnet de chèques, ses cartes de crédit et sa voiture ont disparu. La police prélève des empreintes digitales sur le corps de la victime.

programme.title: Dossiers FBI: Une évasion spectaculaire
programme.desc: En 1987, 7 détenus s’évadent d’une prison à sécurité maximum au Nouveau Mexique. Les hommes, qui sont tous des criminels violents, sont une menace pour tous ceux qui se retrouveront sur leur route.

programme.title: Dossiers FBI: Zone meurtrière
programme.desc: En 1991, l’escouade spéciale Safe Streets constituée d’agents du FBI et de policiers du service de police de Washington, mène une enquête sur les activités violentes du gang de K Street. On soupçonne plusieurs de ses membres d’avoir commis des meurtres.

programme.title: Dossiers FBI: Influence mortelle
programme.desc: Au début des années 80, pendant les guerres de cocaïne qui déchirent Miami, la découverte de trois cadavres pousse un groupe d’intervention à soupçonner un groupe de policiers.

programme.title: Dossiers FBI: Terrorisme intérieur
programme.desc: En 1996, un groupe d’extrémistes cambriole avec une précision militaire une banque de Spokane dans l’État de Washington, à deux reprises en se servant de bombes de fabrication artisanale. Ils prennent aisément la fuite après leurs méfaits.

programme.title: Dossiers FBI: Accident de chasse
programme.desc: En 1983 en Virginie, David Wilkey, 18 ans est tué lors d’un tragique accident de chasse. Malgré l’absence de preuves, l’enquêteur d’une compagnie d’assurance est persuadé qu’il s’agit d’un meurtre.

programme.title: Dossiers FBI: Mafia Dixie
programme.desc: Au Mississippi, sur la côte du golfe du Mexique, un juge et sa femme sont trouvés brutalement assassinés dans leur résidence. Le meurtrier n’a laissé que peu d’indices. L’enquête ne mène nulle part. Les agents du FBI entrent alors en jeu.

programme.title: Save the Wedding
programme.desc: Sparks fly between a best man and a maid of honor as they work together to save their friends' wedding.

programme.title: Betting on the Bride

programme.desc: On a remote island off the coast of Ireland, Pádraic is devastated when his buddy Colm suddenly puts an end to their lifelong friendship. With help from his sister and a troubled young islander, Pádraic sets out to repair the damaged relationship by any means necessary. However, as Colm's resolve only strengthens, he soon delivers an ultimatum that leads to shocking consequences.

programme.title: The Song of Bernadette
programme.desc: Based on the popular novel by Franz Werfel, this drama focuses on Bernadette Soubirous (Jennifer Jones), a young French woman who experiences vivid visions of the Virgin Mary. While many dismiss her claims, certain people, including the priest Dominique Peyramale (Charles Bickford), slowly begin to believe her. Eventually, Bernadette is deemed a saint, and becomes a nun at a convent, where she must deal with jealousy from others who resent her revered status.

programme.title: Hell and High Water
programme.desc: Mercenary sub commander, Captain Adam Jones (Richard Widmark), sells his services to noted atomic scientist Professor Montel (Victor Francen) and his daughter, Denise (Bella Darvi). Professor Montel is convinced the Communists are about to launch a nuclear attack on Korea from an island in the Arctic and blame it on the United States. Captain Jones does not care about politics, but the earnest Professor and his supporters win him over to their cause and they try to thwart the Communist's plans.

programme.title: Voyage to the Bottom of the Sea
programme.desc: Harriman Nelson (Walter Pidgeon) is the creator of a revolutionary nuclear submarine. After testing its capabilities in the Arctic Ocean, Nelson and the commanding officer (Robert Sterling) surface the vessel, only to discover the sky ablaze. Learning that the Van Allen radiation belt has caught fire, Nelson conceives a plan that could save the planet from destruction, but the U.N. shoots it down. Nelson is convinced it will work, but an onboard psychiatrist (Joan Fontaine) questions his sanity.

programme.title: Fantastic Voyage
programme.desc: The brilliant scientist Jan Benes develops a way to shrink humans, and other objects, for brief periods of time. Benes, who is working in communist Russia, is transported by the CIA to America, but is attacked en route. In order to save the scientist, who has developed a blood clot in his brain, a team of Americans in a nuclear submarine is shrunk and injected into Benes' body. They have a finite period of time to fix the clot and get out before the miniaturization wears off.

programme.title: The Neptune Factor
programme.desc: When an earthquake on the ocean floor causes an underwater laboratory to fall into a deep trench and places the scientists' lives in peril, Cmdr. Adrian Blake (Ben Gazzara) embarks on a rescue mission in his small experimental submarine. Along with a crew that includes Dr. Leah Jansen (Yvette Mimieux) and diver Don MacKay (Ernest Borgnine), Blake attempts to save the scientists from the unexplored depths, while encountering gigantic sea creatures that threaten their survival.

programme.title: Alien
programme.desc: In deep space, the crew of the commercial starship Nostromo is awakened from their cryo-sleep capsules halfway through their journey home to investigate a distress call from an alien vessel. The terror begins when the crew encounters a nest of eggs inside the alien ship. An organism from inside an egg leaps out and attaches itself to one of the crew, causing him to fall into a coma.

programme.title: Aliens

Upon arriving at LV-426, the marines find only one survivor, a nine-year-old girl named Newt. But even these battle-hardened marines with all the latest weaponry are no match for the hundreds of aliens that have invaded the colony.

programme.title: Alien 3

programme.title: Prometheus

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Situation difficile
programme.desc: Johanna, bouleversée par les révélations de Linda, explique aux filles qu'elle est profondément déçue par l'attitude de Christian. Sébastien essaie de calmer Nicolas qui est en train de détruire tous les objets personnels de son ancien copain.

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Une brassière à craquer
programme.desc: A la cafèt' les filles entreprennent de commencer la layette du bébé de Linda sur les conseils de Laly. Les garçons se retrouvent au garage où José s'efforce de faire fonctionner son nouveau synthé !

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Baby boom
programme.desc: Laly continue à s'empiffrer comme si elle était enceinte. Hélène et les filles essayent d'en savoir plus sur les relations entre Adeline et l'homme à la moto. Mais Adeline reste très mystérieuse et parle simplement de petits ennuis familiaux...

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: La paëlla
programme.desc: Laly est maintenant persuadée d'être enceinte et décide de faire un test de grossesse. Alors que Christophe confie à José qu'Adeline n'est pas amoureuse de lui, Hélène découvre la jeune fille en larmes dans leur chambre.

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Lendemain difficile
programme.desc: Hélène est partie rejoindre Linda qui poursuit sa convalescence à la campagne. Laly et Nathalie se disputent violemment à propos du bébé de Linda. Nathalie quitte la cafèt' pour aller au garage où elle aperçoit Sébastien seul et endormi.

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Répétition ratée
programme.desc: Sébastien est parti faire du shopping avec Laly pour le futur bébé de Linda et José est occupé à repeindre la cuisine de Bénédicte. Nicolas se retrouve donc seul avec Christophe au garage pour répéter.

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Étincelles
programme.desc: Alors que Laly se sent barbouillée à la suite de plusieurs soirées pizza, elle annonce aux filles qu'elle est persuadée d'être enceinte. Adeline confie à Bénédicte qu'elle ne peut plus supporter Christophe.

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Danger
programme.desc: Nathalie a passé la nuit chez ses amies qui font tout pour l'aider à se remettre de son terrible traumatisme. Pendant ce temps les garçons préparent un plan pour donner une bonne leçon aux trois violeurs...

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Les odieux
programme.desc: Selon le plan établi par toute la bande, les filles se rendent à la boite de nuit où se trouvent les trois voyous. Elles font un tel numéro de charme, que les trois garçons acceptent de les suivre au garage.

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Remerciements délicats
programme.desc: Les filles sont suivies par un mystérieux inconnu à la cafèt'. Pendant ce temps, Nathalie se rend au garage et demande aux garçons de lui permettre d'assister à la répétition.

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Retour en ville
programme.desc: Laly est aux anges depuis que Thierry, après l'avoir suivie, lui a envoyé une lettre pour lui proposer un rendez-vous. Hélène est de retour. Adeline et elle se rendent au garage où se trouvent Sébastien et Nicolas.

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Désordres
programme.desc: Après une entrevue au garage avec Nathalie qui l'assure de son silence, Nicolas retrouve Hélène à la cafèt' et l'emmène au cinéma. À leur retour, Hélène apercevant Nathalie toute seule, lui propose de se joindre à eux mais cette dernière prend la fuite.

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Le copain
programme.desc: Après les confidences de Laly et d'Adeline, Hélène raconte à tout le monde qu'elles ont passé la nuit ensemble à jouer aux cartes. Sébastien confie à Nicolas qu'il a aperçu Adeline au restaurant en tête à tête avec un garçon.

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Le grand jour
programme.desc: Laly explique à Hélène qu'elle a passé la nuit avec Thierry mais qu'il ne s'est rien passé. Au garage, Christophe, qui a découvert qu'Olivier n'est pas vraiment le cousin d'Adeline, s'effondre. Les filles arrivent à la salle de sport

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Encombrement
programme.desc: Pendant que ses amies font du shopping pour trouver un pantalon pour José, Laly prétexte un rendez-vous chez le dentiste. Elle va en réalité retrouver Thierry à la cafet', mais Sébastien les surprend.

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Relookage
programme.desc: Pendant que les filles parlementent pour relooker Christophe, Nicolas remarque que Sébastien est perturbé. Ce dernier lui confie qu'il est très inquiet à propos de Laly qui ne quitte plus Thierry.

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Le grand sommeil
programme.desc: Laly ne sait pas comment se débarrasser de Thierry et Hélène lui conseille d'être directe. Prétextant un voyage, Nathalie demande aux filles et particulièrement à Laly, de prendre soin de son frère...

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Fin difficile
programme.desc: Tout le monde se retrouve au garage pour fêter le rétablissement de Nathalie. Rosy, une jeune fille, débarque à la recherche d'Olivier qu'elle aurait rencontré la veille dans une boîte. Olivier arrive et ne reconnaît pas du tout Rosy...

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Surprise
programme.desc: En arrivant au garage pour répéter, les garçons réveillent Rosy qui a préféré passer la nuit sur place pour attendre Olivier. Tout le monde se prépare à faire une surprise à Nicolas pour son anniversaire

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Carton rouge
programme.desc: José se retrouve chez les garçons avec ses bagages : ne supportant plus ses jeux stupides avec Rosy, Bénédicte vient de le mettre dehors.

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: De la suite dans les idées
programme.sub-title: De la suite dans les idées
programme.desc: Rosy, qui ne peut plus se passer de José, se blesse au pied en voulant s'introduire dans la chambre des garçons. Laly fait sensation à la cafèt' avec son nouveau look à la Audrey Hepburn.

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Déprime
programme.desc: Linda a perdu son bébé et tout le monde est très triste. Laly culpabilise et ne veut plus voir personne, même pas Sébastien. Ce dernier décide d'aller lui parler...

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Rosy
programme.desc: Depuis que Rosy a demandé aux filles de l'aider à séduire Olivier, elles ne se quittent plus. Lorsque Bénédicte annonce, affolée, qu'elle n'a pas pu se procurer de voiture pour aller chercher Linda à l'hôpital, Rosy propose d'en trouver une.

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Concours
programme.desc: Laly annonce à ses amies qu'elle va participer à un concours pour essayer de gagner une voiture. Pendant que celles-ci essaient de l'amener à renoncer à ce projet, Olivier confie à Rosy qu'il est complètement fauché.

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Sauvetage
programme.desc: Olivier est très touché lorsque Rosy arrive au garage, où il a passé la nuit, avec des vêtements et des provisions. Pendant que Laly s'évertue à gagner son concours, Hélène essaye de trouver une solution pour aider Olivier.

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: La leçon de conduite
programme.desc: Olivier a trouvé une place de pizzaïolo. Les filles se retrouvent à la cafèt' et Laly est impatiente d'aller prendre sa première leçon de conduite. Au garage, Nathalie vient annoncer aux garçons que Thomas Fava veut les voir...

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: L'acceptation
programme.desc: Nathalie demande à Hélène de rencontrer Thomas Fava. Ce dernier lui confie qu'il est séropositif et qu'il craint pour la vie de Nathalie... Bouleversée, Hélène décide de persuader Nicolas de faire accepter au groupe les propositions de travail de Thomas.

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Angoisse
programme.desc: Hélène conseille à Nathalie de passer des tests pour savoir si Thomas l'a contaminée. Les garçons font la connaissance de Zaza, la sœur de Rosy. Nicolas confie à Hélène son inquiétude...

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Zaza
programme.desc: Alors que Nicolas est toujours très préoccupé par les risques de contamination qu'il encourt, Laly présente Pascal, son moniteur d'auto-école, à ses amies. Pendant ce temps, Zaza ne cesse de faire du charme aux garçons.

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Un pari stupide
programme.desc: Malgré les moqueries de ses copains, Laly est bien décidée à écrire les paroles de la chanson que les garçons composent pour Thomas. Au garage, ces derniers ont beaucoup de mal à travailler à cause de Zaza qui repousse les avances de José.

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: L'erreur
programme.desc: Olivier est de corvée de nettoyage au restaurant après la bagarre entre Rosy et Zaza. Les garçons découvrent que José a passé la nuit avec cette dernière au garage. Bénédicte, furieuse après la scène qu'elle a eue avec son petit ami, décide de le quitter.

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Nouveau départ
programme.desc: Les garçons doivent répéter leurs chansons, mais José n'est toujours pas arrivé au garage. À la cafèt', Bénédicte vient de prendre la décision de se trouver un autre petit ami. Pendant que Laly continue de prendre des notes pour écrire ses chansons.

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Souvenirs
programme.desc: Laly, qui fait partie des finalistes du concours, est à la recherche d'une auto-école. Rosy, voulant faire une surprise à Olivier, a peint ses tumbas... Sébastien se retrouve en tête-à-tête avec Linda à la cafèt' et ils se remémorent leur idylle.

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Rapprochement
programme.desc: Laly prévient les filles qu'elle sera absente pour la journée car elle va faire un stage intensif de conduite... Alors que Nicolas doit retrouver Thomas Fava au studio, Sébastien attend patiemment Laly à la cafèt'.

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Embarras
programme.desc: Pendant que Laly continue son stage de conduite, Nicolas retrouve Thomas Fava et lui annonce qu'il refuse le contrat. Rosy, décidée à changer de tactique avec Olivier, va voir les filles à la cafèt' pour leur demander conseil.

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Précaution
programme.desc: José fait une scène à Nicolas à propos de la signature du contrat avec Thomas Fava. De son côté, Laly tente en vain de mettre la main sur son code de la route, sous l'œil amusé de ses amies.

programme.title: Hélène et les garçons: Le piège
programme.desc: Pendant que Laly passe sa mauvaise humeur sur les filles, les garçons attendent avec impatience le retour d'Olivier et de Rosy qui ont passé la soirée ensemble.

programme.desc: Among the secret murders explored are Judith Roberts, Mary Judge in Leeds in 1968, a schoolgirl killed in Staffordshire in 1972 and Carol Wilkinson, a bakery worker murdered in Bradford in 1977.

programme.title: Yorkshire Ripper: The Secret Murders
programme.desc: The pressure continues to build on West Yorkshire Police; on top of the crimes that police decide to include in the Ripper investigation, murders and attempted murders with a clear link to the killer are discarded and left unsolved.

programme.title: The Other Lamb
programme.desc: A young woman born into an all-female cult begins to question the teachings of her leader.

programme.title: Rust Creek
programme.desc: A wrong turn leaves a college student stranded in the wintry woods, where she aligns with an enigmatic loner to survive the elements -- and the outlaws pursuing her.

programme.title: The 101 Scariest Horror Movie Moments of All Time
programme.desc: The countdown begins with modern masterpieces and classic fright films from around the world.

programme.title: The 101 Scariest Horror Movie Moments of All Time
programme.desc: Thirteen more iconic moments of fear drawn from the most frightening films ever made, celebrated and dissected by a ghoul's gallery of horror pros.

programme.title: The 101 Scariest Horror Movie Moments of All Time
programme.desc: Thirteen films spanning a century of horror prove that a good scare is timeless.

programme.title: The 101 Scariest Horror Movie Moments of All Time
programme.desc: Thirteen iconic horror moments, featuring werewolves, patchwork men, blood-sucking murder balls, and two Stephen King classics.

programme.title: The 101 Scariest Horror Movie Moments of All Time
programme.desc: Thirteen more iconic scenes from the most frightening films ever made, directed by the greatest names in the genre.

programme.title: The 101 Scariest Horror Movie Moments of All Time
programme.desc: Thirteen more terrifying journeys into fear, featuring found footage, twisted torture, creepy kids, and ghastly ghosts.

programme.title: The 101 Scariest Horror Movie Moments of All Time
programme.desc: The penultimate episode spotlights vengeful prom queens, creative kills, zombies galore, and the greatest jump scare put on film.

programme.title: The 101 Scariest Horror Movie Moments of All Time
programme.desc: The top ten most iconic moments in horror movie history are revealed.

programme.title: Cursed Films
programme.desc: A look into the making of Roman Polanski's "Rosemary's Baby," and the tragic aftermath following the films release.

programme.title: Cold Blooded: The Clutter Family Murders
programme.desc: In November 1959, four members of the Clutter family are brutally murdered in their home in a small Kansas farming community.

programme.title: Cold Blooded: The Clutter Family Murders
programme.desc: Kansas law enforcement survey the aftermath of the seemingly unmotivated crime, while criminals Perry Smith and Richard Hickock go on the lam.

programme.title: Cold Blooded: The Clutter Family Murders
programme.desc: Detailing the resulting investigation and convictions of Perry Smith and Richard Hickock, along with the ensuing media coverage.

programme.title: Cold Blooded: The Clutter Family Murders
programme.desc: As Perry Smith and Richard Hickock face a death sentence, Truman Capote's coverage of the infamous case and his ensuing novel, "In Cold Blood," spawns the modern American True Crime genre.

programme.title: The Killer Clown: Murder on the Doorstep
programme.desc: In 1990, Marlene is shot by a clown and detectives try to find a motive for her murder; her husband Michael becomes the prime suspect after detectives learn their marriage was on the rocks, but an anonymous tip leads investigators to another suspect.

programme.title: The Killer Clown: Murder on the Doorstep
programme.desc: Michael's affair leads detectives to investigate his alleged mistress Sheila; a lead on the costume from a store puts Sheila firmly in the frame, but without evidence the case goes cold; then in 2017, new DNA evidence leads detectives to an arrest.

programme.title: The Killer Clown: Murder on the Doorstep
programme.desc: After Sheila's arrest, the prosecution prepares for trial and the stakes are high; the prosecution's case centers on new DNA and fiber evidence; Sheila's defense attorney attempts to get the evidence thrown out.

programme.title: Wasp Woman: Murder of a B Movie Queen
programme.desc: In 1986, cult actress Susan Cabot is found dead in her Los Angeles home; suspicion immediately falls on her son, Timothy Roman, the only witness and immediate suspect; what begins as a shocking Hollywood murder soon opens into a darker story.

programme.title: Wasp Woman: Murder of a B Movie Queen
programme.desc: The investigation deepens and Timothy's story becomes more complex; Timothy's life was shaped not only by his mother's troubled past but by a chapter in American medical history, as a patient enrolled in a now-buried clinical experiment.

programme.title: Wasp Woman: Murder of a B Movie Queen
programme.desc: Susan's body is discovered in her bedroom, bloodied, broken and surrounded by confusion; Timothy offers a surreal account of masked intruders, but his story unravels quickly; under pressure, he admits the truth.

programme.title: Monkey on a Stick: Murder, Madness, and the Hare Krishnas
programme.desc: The expose of the Hare Krishna movement; investigative journalists uncover a range of criminal activity involving guns, drugs, money laundering, abuse and even murder.

programme.title: Monkey on a Stick: Murder, Madness, and the Hare Krishnas
programme.desc: Part 2 in the chilling exposé of the Hare Krishna movement, investigative journalists uncover a range of criminal activity involving guns, drugs, money laundering, abuse, and even murder; adapted from the New York Times bestselling book.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go: Lui è Tornato!
programme.desc: Entra in squadra un nuovo giocatore, Lucian Dark, nipote del famigerato Ray Dark.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go: Bloccati nella Neve
programme.desc: La Raimon arriva sul luogo della prossima partita, contro l'Alpine Junior High. Si tratta di uno stadio ghiacciato dove il terreno di gioco è costituito da una lastra di ghiaccio molto scivolosa.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go: Battaglia nel Ghiaccio: la Raimon Contro l'Alpine!
programme.sub-title: Battaglia nel Ghiaccio: la Raimon Contro l'Alpine!
programme.desc: Continua l'incontro tra alpine e Raimon. La Raimon continua a tentare di infrangere la barriera assoluta con le ali gemelle, ma senza successo, nonostante l'arrivo e l'entrata in campo di Nishiki.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go: La Preoccupazione dell'Allenatore Sharp
programme.desc: Mark lascia per indagare più a fondo sui piani del Quinto Settore, gettando nello sconforto tutti componenti della squadra.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go: Lo Scontro con la Kirkwood
programme.desc: Continua il programma dell’allenatore Sharp e i ragazzi iniziano a vedere i risultati. Arion e J.P., una volta finito allenamento, chiedono a Ryoma di raccontare com’è stato giocare a calcio in Italia e lui risponde dicendo che è come la pasta.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go: Duello di Strategie
programme.desc: Sia la Raimon che la Kirkwood vengono prese alla sprovvista dagli sprofondamenti, infatti Byron si era rifiutato di farsi descrivere il campo da Alex. Entrambe le compagini si ritrovano quindi bloccate inizialmente.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go: Il Grande Samurai Musashi
programme.desc: La Raimon riesce a pareggiare sul 2 a 2 contro la Kirkwood sempre grazie a Ryoma, che sfrutta il suo Spirito Guerriero.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go: Il Miracolo del Vento della Rivoluzione!
programme.sub-title: Il Miracolo del Vento della Rivoluzione!
programme.desc: Arion e J.P. sono al campo con le ragazze ad allenarsi, e fanno una pausa mangiando delle polpette di riso. J.P. si abbuffa sperando così di riuscire ad immagazzinare l'energia necessaria per evocare uno Spirito Guerriero.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go: Il Mistero dell'Istituto Miraggio
programme.desc: Wanli è decisamente scosso dal fatto che nell’ultima partita non l’abbiano fatto entrare in campo e continua a distrarsi in allenamento. La cosa peggiora dopo che viene comunicato il prossimo avversario della Raimon.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go: L'Imparabile Tiro Fantasma
programme.desc: Sta per cominciare la partita contro l'istituto miraggio e Lucian e tormentato dai dubbi su cosa debba dire a Wanli, dopo il suo incontro con Faythe.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go: Cambio di Portiere
programme.desc: L'intervento di Harrold su Adé gli procura un infortunio al ginocchio, del quale Harrold approfitta per andare al tiro con il suo Spirito Guerriero.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go: L'Incontro Atteso
programme.desc: Shun e Hughes danno la notizia alla squadra che il Quinto Settore è passato alle maniere forti chiudendo alcune scuole che hanno sostenuto la rivolta. La notizia sconvolge tutti, Arion in particolare, che si sente responsabile e scappa al campo al fiume.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go: Il Talento di Cristallo
programme.desc: Samguk propone a J.P. di fare il portiere, ma J.P. è indeciso, teme di non essere all'altezza del ruolo. Arion è preoccupato per lui e mentre è in un parco a rimuginare viene avvicinato da un signore alto che gli fa un discorso sul calcio.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go: Lo Spirito Guerriero di Sol
programme.desc: Semifinali del cammino imperiale. La Raimon si accinge ad affrontare il potente istituto galattico in cui Arion, con suo grande stupore, scorge Sol Daystar, il capitano.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go: Arion Contro Sol
programme.desc: È in corso la semifinale del cammino imperiale fra l’istituto galattico e la Raimon junior high. Si conclude il primo tempo in parità con due goal per ciascuna squadra.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go: Il Nuovo Capitano
programme.desc: L'intervento chirurgico su Riccardo ha successo, ma il capitano della Raimon sarà costretto ad almeno un mese di inattività e riposo, con la gamba ingessata e quindi salterà la finale del torneo. La squadra è scossa e questo si riflette negli allenamenti.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go: La Finale allo Stadio Zenit!
programme.desc: La finale si avvicina. La Raimon continua gli allenamenti sotto la guida del capitano Arion. Quest’ultimo viene coinvolto da Victor nella sperimentazione di una nuova tecnica segreta, tanto che Victor può finalmente concentrarsi unicamente sulla partita.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go: Dragon Link, l'Avversario Supremo
programme.desc: Il primo tempo della finale va avanti colpo su colpo. A ogni goal del monte olimpo la Raimon risponde segnando il pareggio, in un incontro alla pari dove apparentemente anche gli avversari giocano secondo l’istinto.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go: Una Lotta Eroica
programme.desc: Gli attaccanti del monte olimpo, coadiuvati dai loro spiriti guerrieri, lanciano un'ondata di tiri verso la porta della Raimon, alla quale la difesa e il portiere si oppongono disperatamente.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go: Il Nostro Calcio Tocca il Cielo!
programme.sub-title: Il Nostro Calcio Tocca il Cielo!
programme.desc: È già trascorso metà secondo tempo della finale del torneo cammino imperiale. Tutti i giocatori della Raimon sono stremati dal duro scontro. La disperazione di Arion per non essere stato un buon capitano svanisce quando arriva Riccardo.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go: Un Passaggio Verso il Domani
programme.desc: La Raimon, vincitrice del torneo cammino imperiale, si allena. Mentre i giocatori sono al campo arriva il capitano Riccardo di rigo, ancora convalescente. I ragazzi esultano e si stringono attorno a lui festeggiando il suo ritorno.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go: Alla Conquista della Tv!
programme.desc: Tutti i membri della Raimon sono riuniti per assistere allo speciale televisivo a loro dedicato, in occasione dell’anniversario della loro vittoria al torneo del cammino imperiale.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go: Questa è la Raimon!
programme.desc: Continua l'intervista con Mark Evans e Silvia Woods che ripercorrono insieme la nascita del club di calcio della Raimon, quando Mark era l'unico iscritto, e raccontano come la squadra sia pian piano cresciuta, battendosi con avversari sempre più forti.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go Chrono Stone: Il Calcio è Scomparso?
programme.desc: Sono passati tre mesi da quando la Raimon ha vinto il torneo cammino imperiale e Arion non vede l’ora di tornare a scuola per rivedere tutti i ragazzi del club di calcio.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go Chrono Stone: Arion Viaggia nel Tempo!
programme.desc: È in corso la partita tra la squadra di Arion e la Protocollo Omega, che conduce per 1 a 0, quando arriva Wunderbar con una nuova arma per Fey: grazie alla pistola Miximax, infatti, il ragazzo può trasformarsi e diventare molto più forte.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go Chrono Stone: La RInascita della Raimon!
programme.desc: Alpha e gli altri suoi compagni di squadra continuano a giocare duro, con l'intento di indurre il giovane Mark Evans a odiare il calcio, così che non fondi mai il club calcistico della Raimon.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go Chrono Stone: L’Ultima Partita
programme.desc: Victor ha perso la memoria e ha deciso di abbandonare il calcio. L'obiettivo della squadra ora è quello di riportarlo in sé perché ricominci a giocare. Con Vlad, fratello di Victor, vengono trasportati in un'altra dimensione temporale.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go Chrono Stone: Il Calcio è Proibito!
programme.desc: In seguito all’amichevole Giappone-Stati Uniti, in cui il gioco dei locali si è dimostrato scorretto e violento, la legge ha vietato il calcio.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go Chrono Stone: La Protocollo Omega 2.0!
programme.desc: È in corso la partita amichevole tra stati uniti e Giappone rappresentati rispettivamente dalla Raimon e dalla Protocollo Omega 2.0, in vantaggio di 10 punti.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go Chrono Stone: Allenamento al Giardino Imperiale!
programme.desc: È notte e Arion ripensa al suo allenatore Mark che si è sacrificato per salvare lui e la sua squadra. La mattina successiva, assieme a Fey e ai rimanenti membri della Raimon, apprende dalla professoressa Hills.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go Chrono Stone: L’Armatura dello Spirito Guerriero
programme.desc: JP, Arion, Ryoma, Riccardo e Victor si stanno scontrando contro la divisione a5, la squadra formata dai 5 giocatori della Protocollo Omega che vogliono vendicare Alpha.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go Chrono Stone: Gli Insegnamenti del Maestro
programme.desc: I giocatori della Raimon junior high (Victor, Arion, Ryoma, Riccardo e JP) viaggiano nel futuro per introdursi all'interno di un museo commemorativo del calcio che fra duecento anni custodirà un libro, “gli insegnamenti del maestro”.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go Chrono Stone
programme.desc: Arion e gli altri sono a casa di zia silvia e cercano di decifrare i misteriosi quaderni che – secondo le loro informazioni – contengono le istruzioni per creare la squadra invincibile.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go Chrono Stone: Alla Ricerca della Squadra Invincibile
programme.desc: Ricomincia la partita contro la Protocollo Omega 2.0 e il maestro decide di aiutare la Raimon dichiarando che la chiave per la vittoria è in 3d. I ragazzi all’inizio non capiscono e pensano che si riferisca a qualcosa che inizia con la lettera d.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go Chrono Stone: Il Villaggio di Nobunaga
programme.desc: I nostri protagonisti si trovano nel 1554, all'epoca di Nobunaga oda. Il loro obiettivo è cercare di impossessarsi dell'aura di Nobunaga per costituire la squadra più forte di tutti i tempi.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go Chrono Stone: Contro la Banda dei Cervi Bianchi!
programme.sub-title: Contro la Banda dei Cervi Bianchi!
programme.desc: Comincia la sfida tra la Raimon e la banda dei cervi bianchi, ipnotizzati e comandati da beta. Tasuke e i suoi quattro amici si uniscono alla Raimon per ovviare alla carenza di giocatori, ma i ragazzi non hanno idea di come si giochi a calcio.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go Chrono Stone: Operazione Danza
programme.desc: Il gruppo di Arion si trova nel Giappone feudale, con l'obiettivo di catturare l'aura del signore del luogo, tale Nobunaga, e trasferirla a Riccardo. Mentre quest'ultimo si allena per riuscire ad accogliere e trattenere l'aura di Nobunaga.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go Chrono Stone: Allenamento nell'Owari

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy attempts to teach Batty how to be human, while searching for a cure for her new form. A class assignment to capture the mysterious ‘Golden Horn’ and prove who the ‘alpha’ wolf is goes awry when a wilderwolf attacks!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy becomes convinced that there’s a wilderwolf at Howlington, and launches a daring investigation to prove that it’s the school accountant, Mr Sminch. Howlington gets a new teacher, the super cool and charming Ric Rawls.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids are struck down by a flea infestation, and Freddy and Batty are tasked with tracking down the mysterious Doog, keeper of the Fleaminator, the most powerful flea treatment known to dog, before they’re all expelled!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids head out on their first excursion to Night Patrol HQ. Freddy gets pulled into Scarlet’s world as she gets closer to the truth about werewolves and the two bond when they get stuck in the forest while tracking a wolf.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s Howloween, and Howlington is on lockdown. But when the students stage a play that goes wrong and the lockdown is disrupted, it will be up to the kids to save the grown-ups from themselves - including Principal Pincus!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy and Ivan have failed their runes exam and have to do it over - or they won’t be allowed to attend the Doom Wolves concert. But their study session ends up putting themselves, and the Doom Wolves, in grave danger!

programme.title: Back to the Sea
programme.desc: When little fish Kevin is swept up in a net and taken from his home in the vast oceans to the small glass fish tank of a restaurant, he must find a way to escape and make his way back home.

programme.title: Racetime
programme.desc: Frankie and Sophie challenge newcomers Zac and Charlie to an epic sled race.

programme.title: Son of Bigfoot
programme.desc: A teenage boy journeys to find his missing father only to discover that he's actually Bigfoot.

programme.title: Ozzy
programme.desc: The lovable Ozzy’s pampered life is thrown into turmoil after his family drops him at Blue Creek before their vacation. Ozzy quickly learns that Blue Creek is a dog prison and he’ll need to rely on some new friends to help him break out and get back home.

programme.title: Stardog & Turbocat
programme.desc: A loyal dog and a vigilante cat embark on a space age voyage to find their way home.

programme.title: Rally Road Racers
programme.desc: A rookie race-car driver gets the opportunity to compete against the reigning champion. With help from a former driver, he must overcome treacherous terrain, rival racers and unexpected obstacles to prove he has what it takes.

programme.title: Cats
programme.desc: A cat named Blanket lives in the city with his son, Cape. One day, Cape decides to leave home and embarks on an adventure to find the legendary cat's paradise. To find his son, Blanket must overcome his fear and reconcile with his past.

programme.title: Tall Tales
programme.desc: When his beloved Queen bee Marguerite is kidnapped, vagabond cricket Apollo who has been framed for the crime, teams up with the other bugs to save the Queen and the entire kingdom.

programme.title: Luis and the Aliens
programme.desc: A boy at risk of being sent to boarding school by his Dad - and three aliens stranded due to watching too much TV - must help each other out.

programme.title: Boonie Bears : The Big Shrink
programme.desc: After purchasing a mysterious shrink ray machine, Vick accidentally shrinks Briar, Bramble, and himself. The tiny team must put aside their differences and embark on one big journey to restore their size and their friendship.

programme.title: Mission to the Moon
programme.desc: In the international race to the moon, the Norwegian mission is led by brilliant inventor Reodor from the village of Flaklypa. With Louis the Magpie as the brave astronaut, what could possibly go wrong? Quite a bit, actually – on the daring mission, secret passengers are discovered, hidden agendas are revealed, and nothing seems to work out the way it was planned. Louis and his friend Luca the Hedgehog are in for some surprises on their trip to the moon. The third film in the stop-motion trilogy featuring the beloved characters from the Flaklypa universe.

programme.title: Spy Cat
programme.desc: Four crazy anti-heroes, one pawsome adventure. Join special-agent Marnie and her friends as they team up and fight crime. Spoiled and innocent, chubby house cat Marnie lives a comfortable and pampered life in the Sunshine household. She has never ventured outside the family home and only knows about the real world through her favourite detective, crime TV-shows.
