programme.desc: Paul Shull recherche le meilleur fusil de précision de la Seconde Guerre mondiale.

programme.title: Genios
programme.desc: Los hermanos Wright construyen y vuelan el primer avión del mundo. Por su lado, el pionero de la aviación Glenn Curtiss comienza a fabricar y vender aviones provocando una guerra de patentes que amenaza destruir la industria antes de que despegue.

programme.title: Genios
programme.desc: Después de presentar su idea de una televisión eléctrica en la secundaria, Farnsworth, dedica su vida a ese sueño.

programme.title: Genios
programme.desc: Mientras millones luchan y mueren en el campo de batalla durante la Segunda Guerra Mundial, otra importante lucha se libra en los laboratorios de ambos bandos. Oppenheimer gana la carrera en crear la bomba atómica.

programme.title: Genios
programme.desc: Tan pronto termina la Segunda Guerra Mundial, inicia otro conflicto: la batalla de las mentes. Estadounidenses y soviéticos, estancados en la Guerra Fría preparan su lugar en la nueva frontera: la carrera espacial, donde solo uno puede llegar primero.

programme.title: Genios
programme.desc: A mediados del siglo XX, la computadora era una máquina gigantesca que habitaba laboratorios de investigación inaccesibles al público. Pero no por mucho tiempo. En los 80´s, Bill Gates y Steve Jobs inician la carrera por las computadoras personales.

programme.title: Zero Hour
programme.desc: Dos ladrones armados aterrorizan a los empleados y clientes del Banco de América en el valle de San Fernando, North Hollywood, mientras que la policía trabaja desde fuera.

programme.title: Zero Hour
programme.desc: La brutal masacre de diez miembros de la familia real nepalí en junio de 2001 conmocionó al mundo y llevó a una nación al borde de la destrucción.

programme.title: Zero Hour
programme.desc: Seis soldados británicos están encarcelados en una choza en las selvas de Sierra Leona por sus captores, un grupo de milicianos conocidos como los West Side Boys mientras una misión de rescate SAS audaz está a pocos minutos.

programme.title: Historia del automóvil: Mercedes Clase S
programme.desc: Es un fenómeno, el epítome del lujo, el confort y la seguridad, ya que en los años 50 el Mercedes Clase S es el punto de referencia en la clase de lujo.

programme.title: Historia del automóvil: BMW
programme.desc: Si hay un BMW típico, entonces es el BMW Serie 3. Es rápido, es el epítome de la berlina deportiva: el BMW Serie 3. Desde su debut en 1975, la Serie 3 es el líder indiscutible en el segmento premium.

programme.title: Historia del automóvil: AMG
programme.desc: AMG siempre ha sido sinónimo de excelencia automovilística, exclusividad y dinamismo al conducir.

programme.title: Historia del automóvil: Lancia
programme.desc: Vehículos excepcionales y éxitos legendarios en el mundo del motor por un lado, golpes del destino y errores económicos por el otro.

programme.title: El destino del guerrero
programme.desc: Explora el recorrido de los guerreros a través de distintas culturas: desde su infancia hasta la forja de su espiritualidad y su código de honor. Sé testigo de cómo dominan el arte del combate.

programme.title: Reyes de España: Los Reyes Católicos
programme.desc: Reyes Católicos fue la denominación que recibieron los esposos Fernando II de Aragón e Isabel I de Castilla, soberanos de la Corona de Castilla y de la Corona de Aragón

programme.title: Reyes de España: Juana I y Felipe I
programme.desc: Juana de Castilla, hija de los Reyes Católicos y conocida como La Loca fue reina de Castilla junto a su esposo Felipe I desde 1504 y en solitario de Aragón desde 1516

programme.title: Reyes de España: Carlos I
programme.desc: Carlos I, nacido en 1500 y muerto en 1558, gobernó el imperio español desde 1516 y el Sacro Imperio Germánico desde 1519. Éste incluía territorios como Alemania, parte de Italia, los Países Bajos etc.. un total de cuatro millones de kilómetros cuadrados

programme.title: Reyes de España: Felipe II
programme.desc: Con Felipe II, el imperio español alcanzó su mayor extensión.

programme.title: Grandes batallas de la Guerra Civil Española: La batalla de Badajoz
programme.desc: 17 de julio de 1936. Una parte del Ejército en el protectorado español en Marruecos se levanta en armas contra la República española. Y como piezas de un dominó diversas guarniciones en la Península van alzándose.

programme.title: Grandes batallas de la Guerra Civil Española: La batalla de Toledo
programme.desc: Hubo ocasiones en la guerra civil española, denominada por muchos como la primera guerra moderna, que tuvo tintes medievales. Este es uno de ellos.Tras el alzamiento militar, Toledo y su provincia permanecen fieles a La República excepto El Alcázar.

programme.title: FantomWorks: 1963 Corvette, 1931 Ford Modèle A Hot Rod
programme.sub-title: 1963 Corvette, 1931 Ford Modèle A Hot Rod
programme.desc: Dan et son équipe entreprennent la restauration d’une Corvette 1963 et d’une Ford A gonflée de l’année 1931. La Corvette doit être prête à temps pour le mariage de son propriétaire qui aura lieu dans seulement deux mois.

programme.title: FantomWorks: 1970 Chevrolet Chevelle SS, 1926 Velie
programme.desc: En vue d’aider les militaires blessés au combat, Dan, un ancien Bérêt vert, tente l’impossible en transformant une Chevrolet Chevelle SS 1970 en voiture adaptée pour les handicapés.

programme.title: FantomWorks: Ford Mustang 1965, Camion Studebaker 1951
programme.desc: Dan et son équipe entreprennent la restauration d’une Mustang Ford 1965 ainsi que celle d’une camionnette Studebaker 1951. La Mustang appartient à un ami de Dan dont les visées dépassent largement le budget.

programme.title: FantomWorks: Volkswagen Coccinelle 1966, Cabriolet TR6 1976
programme.desc: Dan restaure une TR6 1976 décapotable et une Volkswagen 1966. La Triumph TR6 est en mauvais état, mais Dan voit qu’elle a le potentiel d’être préservée dans son état initial, n’ayant jamais été repeinte.

programme.title: FantomWorks: Chevrolet Impala 1964, Chevrolet Bel Air Wagon 1957
programme.sub-title: Chevrolet Impala 1964, Chevrolet Bel Air Wagon 1957
programme.desc: Dan et son équipe acceptent de restaurer partiellement une Chevrolet Bel Air 1957, mais, à cause d’un malentendu, ils vont plus loin que prévu.

programme.title: FantomWorks: Cadillac DeVille 1965, Chevrolet Monte Carlo 1984
programme.desc: Dan commence la restauration d’une Cadillac DeVille 1965 et d’une Chevrolet Monte Carlo 1984. La Cadillac est si pleine de feuilles mortes et d’excréments de rats qu’elle représente presque un danger pour la santé.

programme.title: FantomWorks: Le sommet de l'iceberg
programme.desc: Quand Matt lui apporte son Avanti 1983 qu’il a restaurée partiellement, il croit se trouver devant quelqu’un de la même trempe que lui. De son côté, Craig arrive avec une camionnette Chevrolet 1951.

programme.title: FantomWorks: Rapide et dangereux
programme.desc: Quand Franco demande une estimation de coûts pour la restauration d’une Corvette Stingray, Dan croit que ces travaux sont une pure perte de temps. Pendant que l’équipe s’escrime à restaurer la Corvette, Clay arrive avec sa Cobra 1965.

programme.title: FantomWorks: Vitesse de Mach
programme.desc: Mike a ratissé tout le pays à la recherche d’un atelier où il pourrait faire restaurer sa Mach 1 qui n’a pas roulé depuis 10 ans. Cette restauration posera de nombreux défis à Dan et son équipe.

programme.title: FantomWorks: Billet pour rouler
programme.desc: Dan et son équipe ont une impression de déjà vu lorsqu’ils voient arriver une Buick 1941 à l’atelier. Son propriétaire, Jerry, leur a déjà demandé de travailler sur la restauration de son auto il y a quelques années avant de changer brusquement d’idée.

programme.title: FantomWorks: La taille importe
programme.desc: Quand Warren arrive avec sa camionnette C10, Dan lui recommande de ne pas faire repeindre sa carrosserie, mais Warren y tient. Il veut faire restaurer son véhicule de fond en comble, car il veut la donner à sa fille.

programme.title: FantomWorks: Méfiez-vous de l'acheteur
programme.desc: Quand Dan Short a acheté le bâtiment qui abrite maintenant son atelier de restauration, il a conclu une entente spéciale avec le vendeur, soit de lui restaurer entièrement la voiture de son choix, le moment venu.

programme.title: FantomWorks: Tout ou rien
programme.desc: Même si sa voiture n’a pas une bonne valeur de revente et que Dan le lui déconseille, Brad tient à faire restaurer sa Mustang Coupé, car elle appartenait à son père, décédé depuis peu, et qu’il compte, un jour, la léguer à son tour à ses propres enfants.

programme.title: FantomWorks: Surprises cachées
programme.desc: En hommage à sa tante qui lui a légué une Plymouth Barracuda 1964, Emmet tient absolument à faire restaurer ce véhicule dont toutes les pièces seraient, d’après lui, originales.

programme.title: FantomWorks: Disputez ceci
programme.desc: Quand Gray confie la restauration de sa Phaeton 1929 aux experts de FantomWorks, plus aucun membre de sa famille ne veut y monter pour se promener avec lui.

programme.title: FantomWorks: Course à l'arrivée
programme.desc: Steve, le propriétaire d’une Oldsmobile Rocket 88 1954 souhaite participer à la course des Mille Miglia qui se tient tous les ans sur les routes sinueuses d’Italie.

programme.title: FantomWorks: Bon après mauvais
programme.desc: En examinant la Camaro 1969 que Butch avait confiée à un autre restaurateur, Dan constate que c’est l’auto la plus mal retapée qu’il a jamais vue. Revenir en arrière et refaire le travail à neuf représentera assurément un défi de taille.

programme.title: FantomWorks: Attendez-vous à l'inattendu
programme.desc: George a toujours rêvé de posséder une Chevelle 1967 et, maintenant qu’il en a une, il souhaite qu’elle soit la plus performante possible.

programme.title: FantomWorks: Vitesse et style
programme.desc: Peu de temps après avoir hérité de la GTO de son père, Al demande à Dan de la restaurer en sa mémoire. Mais des problèmes de moteur et de vilebrequin vont bientôt le forcer à prendre une décision difficile.

programme.title: FantomWorks: Humide et sauvage
programme.desc: Joe pousse les gars de FantomWorks dans leurs derniers retranchements lorsqu’il leur demande de construire la réplique du légendaire hydroglisseur Timossi 1953 qu’il compte utiliser pour battre un record de vitesse sur l’eau.

programme.desc: Danny y su equipo montan una moto Triumph de la Segunda Guerra mundial para un cliente, con la esperanza de que sea un tributo a las raíces militares de su familia. Cuando finalmente la ensamblan e intentan hacerla funcionar, no enciende.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Danny construye una moto de talla mundial para un cliente importante y si todo sale bien, esto podría implicar un nuevo negocio para la tienda. Mike y Ryan buscan el Mustang perfecto, y Kevin sigue el sendero de los recuerdos.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: A regañadientes, Ryan se mete en la personalización de un Cadillac por un proyecto personal, todos en el negocio están contentos de que lo haga, y ven lo bueno que resulta. Danny se siente inspirado de ir a ver una maravillosa colección de Cadillacs.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Shannon llama a los muchachos para que lo ayuden a terminar un regalo para Danny, una moto que comenzó a construir para él hace diez años. Mientras tanto, Danny ve un Corvette de 1969 en un lote de un amigo y no se resiste a visitarlo.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Danny cargo a Ryan con la personalización de un nuevo Chevy Silverado para su cliente más difícil-a sí mismo! Danny quiere que mantenga el sabor de su viejo ' 56 camión, pero está buscando más comodidad y fiabilidad.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.sub-title: Lo rápido y lo ridículo, parte 2
programme.desc: Los chicos finalmente encontrar un coche no tan perfecto para la carrera de los limones de Arizona; un viejo corredor golpeado, que fue una vez propiedad de Shannon.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Dee Twisted Sister Snider trae a Danny y la pandilla de un nuevo BMW Z4 que quiere para su esposa Suzette como regalo de aniversario. Un simple trabajo de pintura se convierte en un desastre cuando Suzette no está contenta con el producto terminado.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: El hermano de Kevin, Steve, quiere reformar una moto Kawasaki KZ100 de 1980 como las de la clásica serie de TV CHiPs.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Parece que cada vez que Danny encuentra un proyecto para el negocio, termina quedándoselo. Ahora Ryan y Kevin están decididos a encontrar un auto que Danny arregle y remodele.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Danny y Shannon están en el cielo cuando les piden restaurar un raro prototipo principal de Harley Davidson Pan de 1957.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: El canal local Fox News quiere renovar su Ford Expedition Storm Chaser con la mejor onda posible. Quieren convertir un VUD común en una unidad móvil de noticias para todo clima que puedan llevar a las escuelas y enseñarles a los niños sobre el clima.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Cuando el vehículo con el récord de velocidad en tierra, el Turbinator, pinchó una rueda a 650 km/h el año pasado, se produjo mucho daño.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Ryan y Kevin van a las salinas Bonneville a ver cómo el Turbinator, un vehículo con el récord de velocidad en tierra, intenta llegar al récord de 800 km/h. Davey pasa por el negocio a pedirle a Danny que lo ayude a vender un clásico Nash de 1951.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Cuando un cliente llega a Count's Kustoms con un hermoso Chevy Nomad de 1955, Danny no puede evitar querer el auto para su colección.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Danny y Ryan tienen grandes planes para un Lincoln bajo. Lonnie, uno de los pintores con mucho tiempo en el negocio, quiere darle al Lincoln bajo una pintura nueva, pero simple, pero eso no sucederá.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Cuando los muchachos de la Serie Mundial de Póker quieren un helicóptero de Count’s Kustoms como el obsequio más importante de Internet, Danny quiere hacer algo especial sin que parezca una valla publicitaria.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos

And the crises keep piling up in Matt's life. His best buddy Barry has just gotten fired from his job, his brainy sister Wendy is getting hitched to her vapid boyfriend Kyle, and the gorgeous Tori Frederking, long-time object of Matt's unattainable adoration, is suddenly back in the picture. Unable to find her, or forget her, Kevin and his buddies launch a massive campaign to locate Abbey.

rating.system: Saskatchewan Film and Video Classification Board

programme.title: Free Birds
programme.desc: Pardoned by the president, a lucky turkey (Owen Wilson) named Reggie gets to live a carefree lifestyle, until fellow fowl Jake (Woody Harrelson) recruits him for a history-changing mission. Jake and Reggie travel back in time to the year 1621, just before the first Thanksgiving. The plan: Prevent all turkeys from ever becoming holiday dinners. Unfortunately, the two birds encounter colonist Myles Standish (Colm Meaney), out to capture feathered friends for all the hungry Pilgrims.

rating.system: Saskatchewan Film and Video Classification Board

programme.title: Star Trek: The Motion Picture
programme.desc: The Federation calls on Adm. James T. Kirk (William Shatner) and the crew of the Starship Enterprise to contain an immense nimbused object that's on a crash course with Earth. After investigating, the crew discovers that the alien cloud harbors artificial intelligence with an ominous primary directive. Crisis strikes when a probe dispatched by the energy cloud attacks the crew, abducting navigator Lt. Ilia (Persis Khambatta). An android look-alike containing her memories shows up soon after.

programme.title: Galaxy Quest
programme.desc: The stars of a 1970s sci-fi show -- now scraping a living through re-runs and sci-fi conventions are beamed aboard an alien spacecraft. Believing the cast's heroic on-screen dramas are historical documents of real-life adventures, the band of aliens turns to the ailing celebrities for help in their quest to overcome the oppressive regime in their solar system.

rating.system: Saskatchewan Film and Video Classification Board

programme.title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
programme.desc: As Adm. James T. Kirk (William Shatner) and Capt. Spock (Leonard Nimoy) monitor trainees at Starfleet Academy, another vessel from the United Federation of Planets is about to try out the planet-creating Genesis Device in a seemingly deserted portion of space. In the process, two of Kirk's officers are captured by Khan (Ricardo Montalban), an enemy Kirk thought he'd never see again. Once more, Kirk takes the Enterprise's helm, where he meets Khan's ship in an intergalactic showdown.

programme.title: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock
programme.desc: Adm. James T. Kirk (William Shatner) has defeated his archenemy but at great cost. His friend Spock has apparently been killed, the USS Enterprise is being scrapped, and starship physician Dr. Leonard "Bones" McCoy (DeForest Kelley) has taken ill. McCoy's odd behavior is evidence he's harboring Spock's katra, or animating spirit, and Kirk seeks to take the Enterprise back to the Genesis Planet and find his friend. Rebuffed, Kirk takes dramatic action that results in war with deadly Klingons.

programme.desc: En esta serie de temas el Pastor Bohr explica en minucioso detalle los métodos de estudio que debemos usar al estudiar las profecías. Vivimos en tiempos proféticos y necesitamos explicar en forma clara y sencilla a dónde estamos en la gran cadena profética y cuáles eventos pronto estallarán en el escenario mundial. Esta serie es el resultado de años de investigación. Al aplicar estos 15 principios, usted mismo podrá entender y exponer las profecías con claridad y poder.

programme.desc: esenredar una red de errores puede ser agotador y complejo. En esta serie aprenderás a discernir lo falso de lo verdadero. El movimiento Davidiano, alias, "La Vara del Pastor", ha atrapado a muchos estudiantes incautos de la Biblia que buscan la "Verdad Presente". Al concluir esta serie usted reconocerá y estará apto para refutar la mayor parte de las doctrinas davidianas, tales como Ezequiel 9, la piedra de Daniel 2, y el reino pre-milenario, así como las referencias bíblicas y del Espíritu de Profecía más usados. Usted tendrá un mayor conocimiento de la verdad al redescubrir la belleza del adventismo, prevenir el engaño y ayudar a alguien que ya está envuelto con un grupo disidente.

programme.title: Cortinas De Humo
programme.desc: En 1844 culmina la profecía más extensa de la Biblia. En el drama có smico supra-humano, las tinieblas lucharon por oscurecer los acontecimientos celestiales que se iniciaron 2300 años antes en el 457 a. C. En rápida secuencia una serie de sucesos golpearon las noticias. Aparece el Espiritismo, nace el Evolucionismo, se incia el marxismo-comunismo, se descubre el Código Sinaítico, se genera un edicto de tolerancia a favor de los judíos, surge la Alta Crítica de la Biblia, nacen los discipulos de Cristo, y las Asociación cristiana de jóvenes (YMCA), las comunicaciones ya se producen por telégrafo (cumpliendo el anuncio de Daniel profeta), y el movimiento cristiano se abre paso anunciando la pronta venida de Cristo.

Soon Haggerty's harried fiancée, Gladys Benton (Jean Harlow), and his dashing friend Bill Chandler (William Powell) are in on a scheme that aims to discredit Connie, with amusing and unexpected results.

programme.title: I Love You Again
programme.desc: Larry Wilson (William Powell) is a wealthy businessman. He's also so incredibly boring that his wife, Kay (Myrna Loy), wants a divorce. But when Larry gets knocked on the head, he discovers that he isn't Larry Wilson at all. He's actually George Carey, a con artist, and his life as Larry has really been a case of amnesia. Now back to his old ways, George plans a con to rob an entire town of their money. But George's fiery ways make Kay reconsider the divorce.

programme.title: Love Crazy
programme.desc: A happily married architect, Steve (William Powell), and his wife, Susan (Myrna Loy), plan a romantic celebration for their fourth anniversary, but their evening is interrupted when Susan's meddling mother, Mrs. Cooper (Florence Bates), stops by for a visit. Later, when Mrs. Cooper eavesdrops on Steve talking with an old flame, Isobel (Gail Patrick), she tells Susan, who files for divorce. Steve, still in love with Susan, decides he must feign insanity to stop the divorce proceedings.

programme.title: Double Wedding
programme.desc: The industrious Margit Agnew (Myrna Loy) fixes her sister Irene (Florence Rice) up with the sensible but meek Waldo Beaver (John Beal), and the couple soon decides to wed, despite Irene's reservations about her boring fiancé. Things take a sharp turn when Irene makes the acquaintance of eccentric artist Charles Lodge (William Powell), who encourages the young woman to drop Waldo and pursue her dreams. Before long, an irate Margit confronts Charles, but their encounter takes an unexpected turn.

programme.title: Evelyn Prentice
programme.desc: John Prentice (William Powell) is a successful attorney who often overlooks his wife, Evelyn (Myrna Loy), as he flirts with other women. When Nancy Harrison (Rosalind Russell), a lovely young client, distracts John, Evelyn takes her own steps towards an affair. However, the man interested in Evelyn turns out to be a criminal, and, in a frantic state, she shoots him. Soon, John is brought on to the case, but suspicions point away from Evelyn. Will she admit her involvement?

programme.title: Manhattan Melodrama
programme.desc: Jim Wade and Blackie Gallagher are two boys orphaned by the sinking of a ship. Upon the death of their guardian, also a survivor of the sinking, the boys go their separate ways. Jim (William Powell) grows up to have a prominent political career, while Blackie (Clark Gable) becomes a casino owner and killer. Despite Blackie's lifestyle, the two men remain bonded through thick and thin. But when Jim runs for governor, his association with Blackie threatens his chances.

programme.title: The Great Ziegfeld
programme.desc: This lively biopic depicts the rise of Florenz Ziegfeld (William Powell), a theater producer who became renowned during the 1920s for his lavish stage productions. Starting out by promoting individual performers, Ziegfeld established revues featuring dozens of women, shows that developed into his famous Ziegfeld Follies on Broadway. His appreciation of women is also apparent off-stage, leading to a love triangle involving actresses Anna Held (Luise Rainer) and Billie Burke (Myrna Loy).

programme.title: A Midsummer Night's Dream
programme.desc: In this classic screen adaptation of Shakespeare's fantastical play, the royal wedding plans of Theseus, the duke of Athens (Ian Hunter) and Hippolyta overlap with the antics of forest fairies, led by Oberon and Titania, and a ragtag troupe of actors. Meanwhile, young lovers, including Lysander (Dick Powell) and Hermia (Olivia de Havilland), deceive each other in amusing ways, and magic adds a mischievous element to this enchanted romantic comedy.

programme.title: Hitler's Madman
programme.desc: The Nazi Heinrich Himmler condemns the Czech village Lidice after partisans kill the Nazi Reinhard Heydrich (John Carradine).

programme.title: Escape From East Berlin
programme.desc: After East Berlin chauffeur Kurt Schroder (Don Murray) decides to escape to West Germany, he begins a plan to dig a tunnel under the Berlin Wall. Soon members of Kurt's family are in on the highly risky endeavor, with friends such as the pretty Erika Jurgens (Christine Kaufmann) also joining the effort. As the group tries to execute its plan, Kurt and the others worry about patrolling police and nosy neighbors, fearing they will be discovered before they can complete the tunnel.

programme.title: Friendly Persuasion
programme.desc: The patriarch of a peace-loving Quaker family, Jess Birdwell, begins to question his pacifist values when the Civil War moves toward his close-knit Indiana community. Meanwhile, Jess's daughter, Mattie, is in love with a soldier, and her brother, Josh, contemplates picking up arms to defend his home lest he be considered a coward. As Confederate forces draw nearer, the Birdwells must make some difficult, life-altering decisions.

programme.title: Fury
programme.desc: Joe Wilson (Spencer Tracy) is an innocent man wrongly accused of a horrible crime while on his way to meet his fiancée, Katherine Grant (Sylvia Sidney). Held at a local jail, Joe is confronted by a frenzied mob and presumed dead after a massive fire. When his attackers aren't brought to justice, Joe, who narrowly escaped the blaze, resurfaces, intent on revenge. Katherine tries to dissuade him from carrying out his vengeful plan, but Joe's anger isn't easily dampened.

programme.title: And Then There Were None
programme.desc: In this suspenseful drama, based on Agatha Christie's mystery tale, 10 strangers are summoned to a remote island. While they are waiting for the mysterious host to appear, a recording levels serious accusations at each of the guests, including Judge Francis J. Quinncannon (Barry Fitzgerald) and Dr. Edward G. Armstrong (Walter Huston), and soon they start being murdered, one by one. As the survivors try to keep their wits, they reach a disturbing conclusion: one of them must be the killer.

programme.title: Murder, She Said
programme.desc: When aging sleuth Miss Marple (Margaret Rutherford) witnesses a murder through the window of her passing train car, she alerts the authorities. Unfortunately, the police are hesitant to take the word of an old lady in lieu of an actual body. Taking matters into her own hands, Marple gets a job as a maid at Ackenthorpe Hall, where she believes the murder took place. There, she must match wits with blowhard Luther Ackenthorpe (James Robertson Justice) if she wants to solve the mystery.

programme.title: The Kennel Murder Case

programme.title: Suspicion

programme.title: THE WAWIES
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: THE WAWIES

programme.desc: Robin devours a cookie and gets the hiccups. Snow White tries to help but now she has hiccups too!

programme.title: IncrediTales
programme.desc: Little Mermaid tries to buy water at a vending machine but it doesn't go quite as expected.

programme.title: IncrediTales
programme.desc: Rapunzel is watching a spooky movie when a spider appears. Spiders can be friendly and great movie night companions.

programme.title: IncrediTales
programme.desc: Sleeping Beauty feels puffed-out after a quick game of hopscotch but Cinderella decides to help her get fit.

programme.title: IncrediTales
programme.desc: It's Easter! Belle and Beast have fun painting eggs, however, Beast is having a bit too much fun.

programme.title: IncrediTales
programme.desc: Time for an Egg Hunt. Alice, Red and Cinderella try to find the most Easter eggs.

programme.title: Counting With Paula
programme.desc: The show features Paula and her friends, Tim, Billy, Chalky, Calc, and the Numbers as they go on exciting adventures in colorful and exotic places. From the Amazon jungles to the deepest oceans, and to the hottest deserts, Paula and friends solve problems, have fun and make more friends along the way!

programme.title: Timmy Time
programme.desc: Being an ‘only lamb in the flock’ Timmy has been used to getting his own way. Now for the first time Timmy is going to have to learn to get along with other little animals. Timmy is going to Nursery! Self-willed and naughty Timmy is going to have to learn how to share things with other youngsters and think about their feelings – not just his. Timmy is a gifted little footballer who needs to learn that it’s not enough to kick the ball – you have to pass it too. Harriet Heron and Osbourne Owl, who run the Nursery are going to have their hands full, but Timmy gets it right in the end with a little help from his friends of the furry, feathery and spikey type.

programme.title: Berry and Dolly
programme.desc: Berry, the little snail boy and Dolly, the ladybird are best friends. Together they discover the world around them, while they make new friends with Balthazar the bee, Flutter the butterfly, Stanley the stag-beetle, Leapy the grasshopper, and many others.

programme.title: Doby & Disy: Exploring Journey
programme.desc: Adorable twin brother and sister, Doby & Disy, go on adventures in the magic forest together with their friends. They learn different colors, figures, songs and communication skills by solving various problems on the way.

programme.title: Stella And Sam
programme.desc: As they explore the world in all its seasons, Stella and Sam have wild adventures and comical mishaps. They make friends and discover many things - especially about themselves. If Sam is bold enough to rescue Fred from the sprinkler, then maybe he really can be brave enough to have a sleepover in the backyard tent. Every day is a new adventure, and Stella and Sam share the joy of discovering that they have what it takes to face the biggest adventure of all... growing up.

programme.title: Kids Planet
programme.desc: Wow, I Never Knew That! is a whimsical, half-hour television series that is jam-packed.

programme.title: Totopang
programme.desc: Totopang follows a cheerful mushroom hero and his fruit-and-veggie friends on gentle.

programme.title: Jenny’s Magic Shop
programme.desc: Jenny and her best friend Blam the Teddy Bear run a magic shop in the town of Dreamville, where everybody can come for magical help. The residents of Dreamville always leave the shop thanking Jenny, but actually, they set the stage for their own miracles, leaving behind in the shop whatever is keeping them from living life and making decisions. After all, the ability to change yourself is the truest form of magic. Jenny and Blam never refuse to help anyone, but it often happens that they’re the ones who need help, since Jenny’s still a kid and Blam’s an eccentric teddy bear.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.sub-title: This Is Not Payback, This Is Karma
programme.desc: The first ever mega leg in race history continues through Hyderabad, India, where teams compete in double the detours and double the road blocks, and travel double the distance.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.sub-title: Getting Down to the Nitty Gritty
programme.desc: The final five teams race through Siem Reap, Cambodia, where they face the second and final double U-turn of the season.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: In the first city sprint, the final four teams race through Manila, the capital of the Philippines, where they have no road blocks and no detours.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: With the $1 million prize on the line, the final three teams travel to New Orleans, where one team is crowned the winner.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: The Amazing Race begins its historic 33rd trip around the world when 11 new teams take off from their homes and travel to their first destination, London, England.

programme.desc: While racing through Scotland in February 2020, teams receive shocking and unprecedented news - for the first time in the show's history, THE AMAZING RACE suspends production due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

programme.title: The Amazing Race

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: Teams race through Switzerland, where Racers bungee jump over 700 feet off the Verzasca Dam.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: Racers travel by private jet to Corsica, France, where they go canyoneering through the beautiful landscape of natural rockslides, waterfalls, and rivers.

programme.title: The Amazing Race

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: Teams travel to Halkidiki, Greece, where they are tested on their spelling and memory skills.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: Racers leave no stone unturned while looking for a clue in Thessaloniki, Greece.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.sub-title: No Room For Error/In the Hands of the Amazing Race Gods
programme.desc: After traveling to seven countries and 17 cities, one team will be crowned the winner.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: Teams begin their adventure from Times Square in New York City, where host Phil Keoghan introduces a new game-changing element, "The Save."

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.sub-title: When You Gotta Go, You Gotta Go
programme.desc: The Race continues through London, England, where the Express Pass is on the line, but several teams' hopes of a first-place finish are capsized while boating in a punt in Oxford.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Considering plastic surgery of any kind? Don't miss Krissy's story and Dr. Ordon's essential do's and don'ts to keep you safe. Watch several controversial potty training techniques in action and see if any of them are right for your child.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: Contagious or Not? Are You at Risk
programme.desc: Find out the 10 most common ailments, and which ones are contagious. Plus, a dangerous virus that often masquerades as a rash. Is your child at risk? And, quick cures for urinary tract infections and the stomach flu.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Fix your biggest pains with food! Learn how what you eat can help heal heartburn, soothe toothaches, ease PMS symptoms and more. Plus, snacks that can make migraines and earaches worse. And, how a dill pickle could ease arthritis.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: Top 5 Questions To Ask Your Doctor
programme.desc: Learn how to interview potential doctors, which tests you need and how to make the most of your next doctor’s visit. Plus, when you need to go to the emergency room – STAT.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: In a THE DOCTORS exclusive, meet the father who had to have his hands and feet amputated after an extremely rare case of strep throat! Don’t miss the moment his family gets the surprise of a lifetime! Then, reality TV star and model Courtney Stodden reaches out to THE DOCTORS for help with depression and drugs and speaks out about her controversial marriage and rocky relationship with her mother! Plus, a doctor’s fight to save his brother’s life requires he become a donor! Then, a guest who was addicted to eating clay pots returns; has she kicked her strange habit for good?

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: People know that smoking causes cancer and continue to puff anyway, but could you be doing something you didn’t know was bad for you? The Doctors reveals some of the health mistakes you never knew you were making.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Think you know what’s to blame for what’s ailing you? Bad skin? Must be the chocolate. Acid Reflux? Probably spicy food? Not so fast – The Doctors shed new light on common problems. Plus, how to get your body back after baby!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: Ways To Take Charge Of Your Health
programme.desc: Is a simple seasoning the culprit for expanding waistlines? Most Americans consume two to three times the amount of salt necessary per day. The Nutrition Twins, registered dieticians, believe excess salt is largely to blame for America’s obesity epidemic. Learn their secret to staying skinny and try the diet designed to kick the salt habit for good! THE DOCTORS joins forces with Iams pet food to support Iams’ Home 4 the Holidays pet adoption program. Learn the health benefits of pets, for both humans and animals alike! A controversial court ruling in a worker’s compensation case may change the way employers hire. Will your weight jeopardize your job prospects? Plastic surgeon Dr. Drew Ordon demonstrates the latest wrinkle-relaxer on 35-year-old Jennifer. See the amazing after results! If you’re trying to lose weight, studies have shown that when you eat may be more important than what you eat. Snacking at the wrong time can increase your weight gain by 50 percent! Find out when to nibble and when to just say no. Pediatrician Dr. Jim Sears uncovers hidden choking dangers for toddlers and demonstrates what to do if your child’s airway is obstructed.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: See the unbelievable recovery of a woman who was diagnosed with a rare and aggressive brain stroke. Did her family’s love turn around her dire prognosis? Do big feet mean big love in the bedroom? And, why are some farts squeaky and others silent? Then, the controversial plan one ER doctor has to combat the opioid epidemic. Could her “Death Diaries” save lives? The best foods for a better brain. And, the perfect bed time story to get you sleeping faster.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: A breakthrough eye surgery allows a legally blind man to see again. And, Brian Littrell of The Backstreet Boys opens up about his 6-year-old son's fight with Kawasaki Disease. Learn how to spot the warning signs in your child.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: My Breast Implants Made Me Sick
programme.desc: In an exclusive interview, a former Playboy Playmate claims her implants made her sick and says she’s not the only one! Derek Hough reveals how he stays fit and gives the inside scoop on his new show! Find out why some parents are potty training their kids … in public! A young man with a family history of early-onset Alzheimer’s turns to The Doctors! What will be revealed? Get the warning signs you need to know! Plus, a hoarder finally finds freedom … how did she do it?

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Whether it’s a tick, a cyst, phlegm or dirt, or if you’ve got something stuck in your eye or ear, get tips to get it out! Plus, are you ready to give birth? Get the safest ways to speed up labor and delivery.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Woman takes justice into her own hands and busts son-in-law who wanted to meet up with her for sex! Dad uses daughter as bait to catch a predator? The Doctors investigates vigilante justice! The Doctors Exclusive: Comedian Kym Whitley in the operating room for her double chin surgery! Decluttering tips from top home organizer. The practical takeaway to get your house back in order! Three great mayo swaps for a healthier lunch!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Give thanks to your well-being this year! THE DOCTORS helps you relish Thanksgiving without spoiling your health. Don’t let your feast deter your diet! Discover delicious calorie-cutting alternatives to your favorite Turkey Day dishes. Plus, learn why it’s OK to pile on the cranberry sauce! It’s a chicken stuffed into a duck stuffed into a turkey – have you ever tried a turducken? Get the nutritional facts and figures on the a-typical bird. Plus, Thanksgiving trends from around the globe. Could they spice up your celebration? Mind your manners! Learn proper etiquette at the table. And, eat too much too fast? Learn what to do if you overindulge.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Tone, tighten and sculpt your booty with celebrity trainer David Kirsch’s signature exercises! And, how to get rid of adult acne, eliminate crow’s feet and look a size smaller in less than 60 seconds!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Improve your health from A to Z! From anti-aging to zits, The Doctors tackle common health concerns and share the latest medical treatments, simple cures and surprising tips to keep you in tip-top shape.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: t’s the plastic surgery show! Heidi Montag reveals her latest plastic surgery procedures and her regrets! GG from Shahs of Sunset dishes on her plastic surgery obsession and reality star Tiffany Pollard shares how cosmetic surgery completely changed her life. Plus, see how the Kardashian’s doctor boosts the booty without a scalpel in just 30 minutes! Go inside the OR to see the surgeries to give you sexy bedroom eyes, a perfect pout, and the ideal hourglass figure!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The Doctors investigates lunchboxes! Could dangerous mold, fungus and bacteria be hiding in your child’s lunchbox? You may want to hit the brakes at the drive-thru … could cancer-causing chemicals be hiding in your fast food? An erotic website offers sex-ed for teens with a new “wellness” hub? A judge’s sentence is raising eyebrows: celibacy as punishment? Get your daily dose of gross with a viral earwax video!
